tei:div.tei:p: ༄/ dha rma dhā tu sta ba sya ṭi ka nī tā rthaḥ ga mbhi ra sya ni dhī phu li taṃ na ma bi ha ra ti sma// ༄༅// chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa'i 'grel pa nges don zab mo'i gter gyi kha 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs pa'i dbu phyogs lags so// (2) chos nyid gnas lugs ji bzhin gzigs kyang ji snyed don kun so sor gsal// gdod nas mngon par rdzogs sangs rgyas kyang gdul bya'i 'gro la lhag par brtse// yon tan dbyer med ngo bo dag kyang glo bur dri mas sgribs pa'i khams// ma rig rmongs pa'i 'gro la ston kyang gzung 'dzin spros pas dben la 'dud// dpag med bskal pa'i sngon nas sangs rgyas kyang*// rgyal sras sems dpa'i tshul 'dzin 'gro la gzigs// rmad byung mkhyen brtse nus pa bsam yas pa// rje btsun 'jam dpal dpa' bo phyag gi gnas// nges don zab mo'i dgongs pa ma 'dres pa// ji bzhin ston pa rgyal ba'i lung gi bsngags// rab dga'i sar gnas bde ldan zhing du bgrod// 'phags mchog klu sgrub gtsug gi rgyan du mdzod// yang zab mdo yi bcud bsdus 'phags pa'i gzhung*// rang rgyud bag chags bzang po'i rten 'brel du// dmigs nas tshig don cha tsam dgrol ba la// sras bcas rgyal bas shis pa'i me tog rtsol// de yang srid rtsa bdag 'dzin bcad de rnam grol bsgrub pa la ma 'bad na srid pa'i 'khor lor bar med du 'khor bas srid pa'i sdug bsngal rgya che la rgyun ring ba 'di las thar mi srid cing*/ rnal 'byor grol ba'i thabs de'ang lam log mu stegs kyi lam dang lam gol (3) nyan rang gi lam lta bu ni theg chen don gnyer gyis spangs nas theg chen gyi lam la 'jug dgos la/ lam mkhan thar pa'i sgron me sangs rgyas la ma brten par sangs rgyas lta ci/ nyan rang gi go 'phang tsam yang bsgrubs mi shes la/ des na sangs rgyas kyi gsung rab la brten dgos so// gsung rab kyi dgongs pa so skye las dang po pas ji lta ba bzhin rtogs dka' bas/

rjes 'jug mkhas pa'i gsung la brten dgos shing*/ spyir bstan bcos rtsom pa mang yang shing rta'i srol 'byed chen po rgyal bas lung gis bsngags zhing 'phags pa la gnas pa klu thog gnyis gang rung la ma brten na rang stobs kyis bka' yi dgongs pa 'grel nus pa'ang dka' bas/ srol 'byed gnyis po'ang zab rgyas gnyis ston tshul gtso che chung tsam las lam ngo bo gcig pas 'gal med du rtog dgos so// de'ang klu sgrub ni dbu ma'i srol 'byed kyi slob dpon yin pas gsung rab kun dbu ma'i gzhung lugs su rtsod med du grub kyang*/ byams chos skor mngon rtogs rgyan rang rgyud dang*/ bar pa gsum sems tsam dang*/ rgyud bla thal 'gyur du 'dod pa dang*/ rgyud bla yang sems tsam du 'dod pa dang*/ chos nyid rnam 'byed yang dbu mar bzhed pa dang*/ mdo rgyan yang yig cha dngos ma mthong yang dbu mar bzhed pa byung bar (4) thos shing*/ mngon rtogs rgyan yang thal 'gyur du 'dod pa sogs mang du byung yang thal rang gnyis tha snyad zhal bzhes tsam las mthar thug gi lta ba khyad par med la/ byams chos bar pa sems tsam du 'dod pa la sgrub byed med cing gnod byed yod pa'i phyir/ chos nyid rnam 'byed mkhas pa gzhan gyi dbu mar bsgrubs zin la/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub gsum ston pa dang gzhi yi skabs rigs chad bstan pa rigs dang snying po tha dad du ston pa dang*/ theg gcig drang don dang theg pa gsum ston pa nges don du 'dod pa dang*/ gnas gyur bzhed pa dang rnam shes tshogs brgyad bstan pa sogs kyis sems tsam du 'dod na'ang de tsam sgrub byed rnam dag tu ma nges te/ kun brtags gzhan dbang yongs grub bstan pas sems tsam du 'gyur na mngon rgyan yang der 'gyur te/ de ma rdzogs dang rab rdzogs dang zhes sogs ngo bo nyid gsum la sbyar dgos pa'i phyir/ rtsa sher dang bzhi brgya pa sogs la'ang sems tsam pas ngo bo nyid gsum gyis 'chad dgos pa'i phyir/

'di gnyis kyang sems tsam du thal ba dang*/ ngo bo nyid gsum dbu sems gnyis char gyis khas len pa la 'gal ba med de/ bden pa gnyis/ gzhi lam 'bras gsum la sogs pa ltar/ gsung rab 'chad pa'i 'ching tsam yin pa'i phyir dper na shes bya gzhi (5) lnga bye smra kho nas 'dod pa 'chad mi rung ba bzhin no// rigs chad sogs rigs lnga'i dbye ba gnas skabs tsam dbu mas kyang 'dod dgos la gtan tu rigs chad ston pa mdo rgyan na gsal kha med kyang sems tsam rang 'dod kyis sbyar ba tsam du zad pas so// mthar thug theg pa gcig dang gsum go zlog ste 'chad na mdo rgyan gyi rtsa tshig dang shin tu 'grig cing sems tsam ltar na kyog bshad byed 'dug pa dang*/ rigs dang snying po tha dad du bshad pa mdo rgyan na zur tsam du med kyang*/ sems tsam pas rang gar sbyar ba dang*/ rnam shes tshogs brgyad dang gnas gyur 'dod pas der 'gyur na/ rgyud bla dang chos dbyings bstod pa dang byang chub sems 'grel sogs nges don gyi mdo rgyud mtha' dag sems tsam pa'i gzhung du khas len dgos par 'gyur la/ mdo rgyan sogs byams chos bar pa 'di dag sems tsam du bkral 'dug pas der nges snyam na/ klu sgrub dang byams pa'i gsung mtha' dag dang sher phyin sogs mdo rgyud mtha' dag der 'gyur te/ sems tsam dang mthun par bkral ba'i phyir/ des na byams chos bar pa gsum sems tsam kho nar ma sbyar 'os med kyi lung rigs gang yang med pas dbu ma ltar shin tu 'chad bde'o// des na byams pas bde gshegs snying po (6) bsgrub pa'i tshul bstan pa kun rdzob gsal ba'i ldog cha dang*/ klu sgrub kyis mtha' bzhi skye med sogs kyis spros pa gcod pa don dam stong pa'i ldog pa gtsor ston yin pas 'di gnyis bden gnyis dbyer med gcig tu ma shes na stong pa phyang chad gnas lugs khas len nas snying po drang don du 'chad pa dang*/ sems tsam ltar snying po bden grub tu phyogs so sor khas len na/

bden gnyis kyi lam las nyams pas thar lam gyi rtsa ba stor te/ dbu ma 'jug pa las/ slob dpon klu sgrub zhabs kyi lam las ni// phyi rol gyur la zhi ba'i thabs med do// de dag kun rdzob de nyid bden las nyams// de las nyams pa thar pa grub yod min// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnod byed kyang yod de/ mdo rgyan de kho na nyid kyi le'u dang*/ chos tshol gyi skabs dang*/ phar phyin le'u sogs su chos thams cad bden med bstan pa dang*/ dbus mtha' rnam 'byed rang bzhin gsum gyis mtshan nyid ston pa dang*/ de kho na nyid dang*/ stong nyid bco brgyad bstan pa sogs/ mdor na rang bzhin gyi chos thams cad stong nyid rang bzhin med pa kho na ston 'dug pa'i phyir ro// de'ang gzur gnas blo ldan gyis legs par dpyad na shes pas gzhung nyid kyi steng du rtogs par bya'o// yang mngon rtogs (7) rgyan thal 'gyur du sbyar mi rung bar 'dod pa'ang*/ de ltar nges pa med de/ gzhung nyid las mtshan mar 'dzin pa'i cha nyan rang gi lam dang*/ mtshan med spros bral gyi ldog pa de'i gnyen po'i tshul du byang sems kyi lam bstan cing bden grub ston pa zur tsam yang med cing*/ 'phags seng gi 'grel pa las kyang*/ bden grub ston pa med la/ rang rgyal skabs/ gzung don rtogs pa spongs phyir dang*// zhes pa yang*/ bden 'dzin med kyang 'khor gsum rnam rtog la dgongs te/ rgyud bla las/ ser sna la sogs rnam rtog gang*// de ni nyon mongs sgrib par 'dod// 'khor gsum rnam par rtog pa gang*// de ni shes bya'i sgrib par 'dod// ces dang*/ sher phyin mngon rtogs rgyan rang gi gzhung las bstan pa gzung 'dzin dbang du byas pa yin gyi gzhan du gzhung nyid las 'phags pa la rdzas 'dzin med par bshad pa dang 'gal zhing*/ byams pas sher mdo'i dgongs pa ma rtogs par 'gyur zhing yang na mngon rtogs rgyan sher phyin gyi dgongs 'grel min par 'gyur te mdor na chos thams cad bden med bstan pa kho nar nges pas so// des na shes sgrib bden 'dzin ston pa mngon rtogs rgyan gyi bstan don mthar thug ma yin cing*/

nyan rang gi chos thams cad bden med ma (8) rtogs pa'ang mi 'thad de/ mdo dang bstan bcos gnyis rgyab 'gal du thal ba'i phyir dang*/ slob dpon 'ga' zhig gis rang rgyud du bkral bas thal 'gyur du sbyar mi rung ba'ang min te/ gzhan du rtsa sher rang rgyud du bkral bas thal 'gyur du 'chad mi rung bar khas len dgos la/ des na gang ltar yang 'chad du btub mod/ mthar thug dgongs pa thal 'gyur ltar gnas shing*/ thal rang gi khyad par gtso bo don dam dpyad pa'i tshul gsum thal 'gyur dang rang rgyud 'dod pa'i sgo nas 'byed dgos shing mtshan yang de ltar chags pa yin no// des na dngos bstan stong nyid kyi ldog pa gtso bor ston/ klu sgrub kyi gzhung yin pas don dam gtan la 'bebs tshul klu sgrub de yi rjes su 'brang dgos pas/ sbas don gyi skabs su don dam dpyad pa'i rigs pa gtsor ston mi byed cing lam mngon rtogs gtsor ston byed pas thal rang gi dbye gzhi gtso bo min pas thal rang gang ltar yang sbyar du btub bo// des na thal 'gyur du 'chad pa la gnod byed med cing*/ sgrub byed yod de/ dngos bstan stong nyid de gtso bo thal 'gyur ltar gnas na/ shugs bstan lam mngon rtogs de'ang thal 'gyur ltar gnas dgos te/ gzhung sher mdo gcig gi bstan don lam gyi ngo bo gcig yin pa'i phyir/ (9) gzhan du mdo yi dngos bstan mthar thug thal 'gyur dang*/ shugs bstan mthar thug rang rgyud dang*/ yang mdo nyid thal 'gyur gyi dgongs don ltar gnas la/ de yi dgongs 'grel bstan bcos rang rgyud kho nar nges na bstan bcos mkhan po la sgro bkur dang dpyad na bzhad gad gyi gnas su 'gyur ba'i phyir ro// des na byams chos sde lnga dang*/ mgon po klu sgrub kyi gsung rab kun/ sems tsam rang rgyud thal 'gyur gsum char gyis 'chad rung ba gzhung gi khyad chos yin te/ gang zag gcig char ba dang rim gyis pa dkri ba'i lam mtha' dag gzhung re re la tshang ba'i phyir ro// skabs kyi 'chad bya dngos ni/

'phags pa klu'i gsung rab gtam tshogs rnams bka' dang po'i dgongs 'grel/ rigs tshogs rnams bar pa'i dgongs 'grel/ bstod tshogs rnams tha ma'i dgongs 'grel 'chad pa yod pas/ de ltar yang rung mod/ 'dir ni rigs tshogs rnams/ gzhi lta ba gtso bor ston cing*/ gtam tshogs kyis lam/ bstod tshogs kyis 'bras bu gtso bor ston pa las bstod tshogs kyis gtso bo chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa 'di 'chad pa la don gsum te/ mtshan don/ gzhung don/ mjug don smos pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mtshan dang*/ 'gyur phyag go / (10) dang po ni/ rgyaṃ gaṃr skadaṃ duṃ/ dhaṃrmaṃ dhāṃ tuṃ bhaṃ baṃ/ bodaṃ skaṃd duṃ/ choṃs kyiṃ dbyiṃngs suṃ ste rang bzhin la che ba'i yon tan brjod pas bstodaṃ pa'oṃ// de'ang dbyings dang*/ rang bzhin dang*/ rgyu rnams ni don gcig pas stong rkyang la dbyings su go bar mi bya ste/ gsal stong zung 'jug 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings zhes pa'i don to// gnyis pa ni/ 'phaṃgs paṃ 'jaṃm dpalaṃ gzhoṃn nuṃr gyuraṃ paṃ laṃ phyagaṃ 'tshalaṃ loṃ// gnyis pa la gnyis/ dri bcas de bzhin nyid la bstod pa dang*/ dri bral chos sku la bstod pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ chos dbyings 'pho 'gyur med par bstan pa dang*/ glo bur gyi dri ma don la ma grub par bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ mdor bstan pa dang*/ dpe yi sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ chos dbyings gangaṃ zhiṃg gnas skabs kuṃn tu maṃ sheṃs naṃ/ 'dod khams gzugs gzugs med de sridaṃ paṃ gsumaṃ duṃ las nyon gyi dbang gis rnamaṃ paraṃ 'khoraṃ ba/ seṃms canaṃ kunaṃ laṃ rang bzhin gyi tshul du ngesaṃ par gnasaṃ paṃ'i/ chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs glo bur dri bcas ste de'i tshul ni yang dag ma yin pa'i kun tu rtog pa dang*/ de bskyod pa'i las dang nyon mongs pa sdug bsngal ba thams cad ni sems nyid rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa la gos pa med pa'i tshul du gnas kyang dbyings rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba de nyid skye 'gag gnas gsum dang bral ba'i tshul

(11) gyis 'dus ma byas pa'i rang bzhin yin pas de ni gang la yang mi brten te/ rgyud bla ma las/ tshul bzhin ma yin yid byed ni// sems kyi dag pa la rab gnas// sems kyi rang bzhin chos rnams ni// gang la yang ni gnas pa med// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de laṃ phyagaṃ 'tshaṃl zhing 'dudaṃ pa'i don to// chos dbyings gaṃng zhigaṃ 'khoraṃ baṃ'i rgyuraṃ ram rang bzhin du gyuraṃ paṃ/ dbyings deṃ nyidaṃ lam gyis sbyangaṃ baṃ byasaṃ paṃ lasaṃ/ dgaṃ paṃ gnyis ldan du gyur pa de nyiṃd la myaṃ nganaṃ las 'dasaṃ pa zhes bya zhing mthar thug chosaṃ kyiṃ skuṃ yangaṃ deṃ nyidaṃ doṃ// sems can kun la chos dbyings nges par yod na ci yi phyir mi mthong snyam na/ gnyis pa la gnyis/ khams yod par sgrub byed dpe drug gis spyir bstan/ dpe gsum gyis de nyid 'phel 'grib med par bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ dpe gsum gyis khams gyi gnas lugs spyir bstan pa dang*/ phyi ma gsum gyis yod pa'i 'thad pa bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaṃr 'oṃ maṃ dngaṃ 'dresaṃ pasaṃ na/ 'o ma'i gnas skabs su maraṃ gyiṃ snyingaṃ po miṃ snangaṃ baṃ/ dpe deṃ bzhiṃn du nyonaṃ moṃngs dngaṃ 'dresaṃ pasaṃ na/ 'khor ba'i gnas skabs na chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs kyangaṃ dngos su miṃ mthongaṃ ngoṃ*// 'o na nam gyi tshe (12) mthong snyam na/ jiṃ ltaraṃ 'oṃ maṃ rnaṃm par sbyangaṃ ste bsrubs pasaṃ/ maraṃ gyiṃ snyiṃng po dri ma medaṃ paṃr snang bar 'gyuraṃ ro// deṃ bzhiṃn nyonaṃ mongaṃs rnamaṃs rnam par sbyangaṃs pasaṃ/ chosaṃ kyi dbyiṃngs sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa dag ste shinaṃ tuṃ driṃ ma medaṃ pa'i chos skur 'gyuraṃ ro// 'di ni gzhi yi gnas skabs su yod pa'i don to// 'o na sngar med gsar skye 'gyur snyam na/ ma yin te/ khams kyi rang bzhin yon tan ye ldan de nyid rim gyis dri ma dag stobs kyis mngon par gsal ba yin ces bstan pa ni/

ji ltaṃr maṃr meṃ bumaṃ nangaṃ gnasaṃ pa de/ cungaṃ zhiṃg kyang snaṃng b.raṃ miṃ 'gyuraṃ baṃ/ dpe deṃ bzhiṃn du nyonaṃ moṃngs pa'i bumaṃ nangaṃ gnaṃs pa'i chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyingaṃs kyangaṃ so skye tha mal pas miṃ mthoṃng ngoṃ*// phyoṃgs niṃ g.yas g.yon sogs gaṃng dngaṃ gaṃng dgaṃ nasaṃ/ bumaṃ pa laṃ buṃ gaṃ gtoṃd par gyuraṃ paṃ bu ga deṃ dngaṃ*/ deṃ yiṃ phyoṃgs nyiṃd nasaṃ 'odaṃ kyiṃ raṃng bzhinaṃ gsal bar 'byuṃng b.raṃ 'gyuraṃ ro// dpe de bzhin du rigs can gsum gyi rim pa ltar/ nyan thos kyis gang zag gi bdag med dang*/ rang rgyal gyis de steng gzung med dang*/ byang sems kyi gzung 'dzin gnyis med spros bral rtogs pa yin no// yang na byang sems so skyes dbyings don spyi tsam las mi rtogs la/ 'phags pa sa dang po nas rtogs pa rim (13) gyis sa bcu'i bar 'phel ba la sbyar rung ngo*// sa bcu rgyun mtha'i dus gaṃng giṃ tiṃng nge 'dziṃn tshe rdoṃ rjeṃ lta bu yisaṃ/ las nyon gyi bumaṃ paṃ deṃ niṃ mtha' dag bcaṃg par gyuraṃ paṃ/ dus deṃ yi tsheṃ dper na mar me des phyogs bcu kun tu gsal ba ltar snying po chos sku deṃ niṃ namaṃ mkha'aṃ yiṃ/ mthaṃr thugaṃ pa'i b.raṃ duṃ/ ji lta ba dang ji snyed pa'i dngos po ma lus pa snaṃng baṃr byedaṃ de mkhyen par 'gyur ro// 'dis lam gyi gnas skabs na yod par ston to// des na las nyon zad pa tsam las sangs rgyas pas na chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyingaṃs niṃ skyeṃ ba maṃ yiṃn cing*/ dri bcas kyi gnas skabs lta bu naṃm yaṃng 'gaṃg paraṃ 'gyuraṃ baṃ medaṃ do// des na khams rang gi ngo bo la bsam na glo bur gyi dri bcas dang dri med kyi gnas skabs dusaṃ rnaṃms kunaṃ tuṃ nyoṃn moṃngs gshis la zhugs pa medaṃ de/ thogaṃ maṃ gzhi yi gnas skabs dang*/ b.raṃ lam zhugs kyi gnas skabs dang*/ mtharaṃ 'bras bu'i gnas skabs gsum char du ngo bo la khyad par med pa driṃ ma dang bralaṃ baṃ'o// mdor na ngo bo la spang bya'i dri ma bral ba'i don to// 'o na dri ma gshis la med cing gdod nas yon tan mtha' dag ldan na stobs sogs kyi phrin las 'jug dgos so snyam na ma yin te/
dpe jiṃ ltaṃr na/

(14) riṃn po cheṃ baiṃ ḍūṃryaṃ de nyid 'ching bu las grol ma grol ba'i dusaṃ rnaṃms kunaṃ tuṃ yang ngo bo 'odaṃ gsalaṃ yaṃng*/ rdoṃ yiṃ naṃng naṃ gnaṃs par gyuraṃ pa'i gnas skabs naṃ/ nor bu deṃ yiṃ 'odaṃ niṃ gsaṃl ba maṃ yiṃn no// deṃ bzhiṃn glo bur ba'i nyonaṃ mongaṃs kyisaṃ bsgribaṃs pa'iṃ/ chosaṃ dbyingaṃs ngo bo la shinaṃ tuṃ driṃ ma meṃd paṃ yin na'aṃng*/ 'khoṃr b.raṃ phrin las kyi 'oṃd niṃ gsaṃl ba maṃ yiṃn te glo bur gyi dri ma dang ldan pa'i phyir/ las nyon zad de myaṃ nganaṃ las 'daṃs naṃ rtag khyab lhun gyis grub pa'i phrin las kyi 'oṃd gsaṃl bar 'gyuraṃ ro// yon tan mtha' dag ye ldan du bstan te/ 'di ni 'bras bu'i gnas skabs la dgongs pa'o// gnyis pa la 'thad pa dpes bstan pa dang*/ don bsdu ba'o// dang po ni/ khamaṃs so gser gyi rigs yoṃd naṃ niṃ de sbyangs ba'i lasaṃ byasaṃ pasaṃ/ saṃ leṃ sbramaṃ gser dgaṃ mthoṃng b.raṃ 'gyuraṃ la/ khamasaṃ medaṃ par gyur naṃ niṃ laṃs byasaṃ naṃ yang*/ nyonaṃ moṃngs te dka' tshegs 'ba'aṃ zhigaṃ bskyedaṃ paraṃ zaṃd kyi dgos pa gang yang mi 'grub bo// dpe de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi khams sems can la med na lam sgrub pa don med par 'gyur ro// des na da lta nas khams yod dgos so// 'o na da lta nas sangs rgyas kyi khams dngos yod na sems can kun sangs rgyas su khas len dgos snyam na/ ma (15) yin te/ dpe jiṃ ltaṃr na sbunaṃ pasaṃ g.yoṃgs par gyuraṃ pasaṃ/ soṃ baṃ spu las ma grol ba de dngos su longs spyad 'os kyi 'braṃs buraṃ miṃ 'doṃd pa ltaṃr/ dpe deṃ bzhiṃn du glo bur gyi nyonaṃ moṃngs pa rnams kyisaṃ g.yoṃgs pasaṃ na/ khams deṃ niṃ ngo bo ye dag gi sangaṃs rgyasaṃ yin yang dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangs rgyas zheṃs miṃ brtagaṃ ste mi bya'o// jiṃ ltaṃr so ba sbunaṃ paṃ lasaṃ grolaṃ ba naṃ dngos su spyad rung ba'i 'braṃs buṃ nyid snaṃng b.raṃ 'gyuraṃ baṃ ltaraṃ/

deṃ bzhiṃn du glo bur gyi nyonaṃ moṃngs lasaṃ grolaṃ ba naṃ/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chosaṃ kyiṃ skuṃ nyidaṃ raṃb tuṃ gsaṃl ba na sangs rgyas nyid ces bya'o// 'o na ngo bo ye dag gi sangs rgyas cha sems can min la las nyon gyi rang bzhin sangs rgyas yin pas nyon mongs pa'i rang bzhin 'khor ba'i sems can sangs rgyas su 'gyur ba mi srid de rdzas tha dad 'brel med yin pa'i phyir snyam na/ skyon med de/ 'khyag rom gyi ngo bo chu yin pa ltar 'khor ba'i ngo bo sangs rgyas kyi khams yin cing 'khor ba'i rdzas grub pa med pas ye nas 'khor 'das kyi 'brel ba grub pa'i tha snyad thob bo// de'ang me yi tsha ba dang chu yi gsher ba dang nyi ma dang 'od zer ltar yon tan nam yang 'bral ma myong la/ mar me la sgrib byed bum pa dang*/ chu la rdul dang*/ nyi ma la sprin ltar glo bur gyi nyon mongs kyis gos (16) ma myong zhing nyon mongs rang gi ngo bo grub ma myong ste des na glo bur ba zhes bya'o// des na lam gyis sbyangs nas 'khor ba glo bur ba dag na sangs rgyas su 'gyur ro zhes bstan pa ni/ chuṃ shiṃng gi sdong po la snyiṃng poṃ medaṃ doṃ zheṃs/ 'jigaṃ rtenaṃ naṃ niṃ dpeṃr byeṃd mod kyangaṃ*/ sdong po deṃ yiṃ 'braṃs buṃ ni snyiṃng poṃ nyiṃd/ mngaṃr poṃ 'byung ba de zaṃ b.raṃ byedaṃ cing de nyid chu shing gi 'bras bu ma yin zhes kyang brjod mi nus paṃ ltaṃr/ dpe de bzhin du snyiṃng poṃ medaṃ pa'iṃ las nyon gyi sgrib pa'i 'khoraṃ baṃ lasaṃ/ nyonaṃ moṃngs pa'i gzebaṃ daṃng bralaṃ bar gyuraṃ pa naṃ/ 'khor ba 'khrul pa bral ba deṃ yiṃ 'brasaṃ buṃ sangasaṃ rgyasaṃ sku gsum gyi bdag nyidaṃ mngon du gyur pa de/ lusaṃ canaṃ kunaṃ gyiṃ nyon mongs pa'i nad 'joms pa'i bdudaṃ rtsiṃ lta bur 'gyuraṃ ro// dpe 'di gsum gyi don rim pa bzhin dbyings yod pa dang*/ de glo bur gyi dri mas sgrib pa dang*/

dri ma glo bur ba yin pas spang na sangs rgyas thob rung du bstan to// gnyis pa ni/ deṃ bzhinaṃ du 'jig rten na rgyu saṃ boṃn thamaṃs cadaṃ laṃs rgyuṃ dngaṃ 'draṃ baṃ'i 'brasaṃ buṃ thams cad 'byungaṃ ngo*// rgyu saṃ boṃn medaṃ paraṃ 'brasaṃ bu 'byung ba yodaṃ paraṃ shesaṃ ldaṃn gyi gangaṃ zag gang gisaṃ sgrubaṃs paṃr nusaṃ te mi nus so// de bzhin du 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi saṃ bonaṃ du gyuraṃ paṃ khamasaṃ deṃ nyidaṃ/ sangs rgyas gyi stobs sogs chosaṃ rnamaṃs kunaṃ gyiṃ rtenaṃ nam rgyu nyid duṃ 'dodaṃ pa'i (17) khams de'i dri ma rimaṃ gyisaṃ sbyangaṃs b.raṃ gyuṃr paṃ laṃs ni/ bral smin drug cu rtsa bzhi'i bdag nyid sangasaṃ rgyasaṃ kyi goṃ 'phaṃngs thobaṃ paraṃ 'gyuraṃ gyi gzhan rgyu khams med na de thob par mi 'gyur ro// gnyis pa 'phel 'grib med par bstan pa ni/ 'o na tha mal pa'i rgyu 'bras ltar yin na sa bon gyi gnas skabs 'bras bu dngos su med cing*/ sa bon 'gags dgos pa dang*/ 'bras bu yang gsar skye yin pa de bzhin du 'khor ba bden grub gcig 'gags nas sangs rgyas kyang gsar skye dang 'dus byas su 'gyur ba'i phyir zhe na/ skyon med de phyogs tsam 'dra mod/ rnams kun tu 'dra ba ma yin te/ lan rim pa ltar bstan pa ni/ dpe ji ltar na/ ngo bo la rdul sogs kyi driṃ ma medaṃ cing 'od dang 'od zer gyi mdangs dang 'bral mi shes par ldan pa nyiṃ maṃ dang zlaṃ baṃ yangaṃ glo bur gyi sprinaṃ dngaṃ khugaṃ rnaṃ dang duṃ baṃ dngaṃ*/ sgraṃ gcanaṃ gyi gdongaṃ mjug dang rdulaṃ laṃ sogasaṃ paṃ/ sgribaṃ paṃ lngaṃ yiṃs sgribaṃ paraṃ gyuraṃ pa/ dpe deṃ bzhiṃn 'odaṃ gsalaṃ baṃ yiṃ semaṃs bde gshegs snying po rang byung gi rigs pa lhan cig skyes pa'i ngo bo rang bzhin gyis 'od gsal ba thog ma med pa nas spros pa med pa'i bdag nyid dam pa stobs sogs yon tan gyi dkyil 'khor gang bas mdzes pa ni nyi zla

(18) sgrib pa med pa ltar skyon ye zad dbyings chos nyid nam mkha' lta bu rang bzhin las mi g.yo bar 'dus ma byas lhun grub chen por ye nas gnas pa'i rang bzhin rnam dag snang stong dbyer med chen por gnas pa nyid yin yang glo bur gyi dri ma 'dod pa'i 'dodaṃ chags srid pa slan par byed pa'i sprin lta bu dngaṃ*/ zhe sdang gi mes bskyed pa'i gnodaṃ semasaṃ du ba lta bu gnyis kyis tshul khrims dang*/ gti mug gis mi gsal bar byed pa leṃ loṃ khug rna lta bus gsum char la dngaṃ*/ sems rgodaṃ paṃ nga rgyal dngaṃ bcas pa sgra gcan gyi gdong lta bus ting nge 'dzin dang niṃ/ lta ba sna tshogs kyis bskyed pa'i theṃ tshomaṃ rdul 'tshubs pa lta bus shes rab la sgrib pa steṃ/ des na sgribaṃ paṃ lngaṃ yisaṃ rang bzhin la gos pa med kyang 'khrul snang du sgrib pa ltar snang nas sgribaṃ paṃr gyuraṃ to// des na sa bon la myu gu 'byung rung gi nus pa tsam las mtha' gcig tu mi 'dra ste yon tan kun ye ldan yin pa'i phyir ro// 'dis ni gzhi yi gnas skabs su 'phel 'grib med par bstan to// dpe jiṃ ltaṃr na meṃ yiṃs dgaṃ pa'iṃ lha yi gosaṃ/ snaṃ tshoṃgs pa'i driṃ maṃs driṃ maṃ can du gyur pa deṃ/ jiṃ ltaṃr meṃ yiṃ nangaṃ du bcugaṃ pa naṃ/ driṃ maṃ mtha' dag tshig par 'gyuraṃ gyi gosaṃ ni tshig pa minaṃ pa ltaṃr/ (19) deṃ bzhiṃn 'oṃd gsalaṃ baṃ yiṃ semaṃs de nyid/ 'dodaṃ chaṃgs laṃ sogaṃs pa glo bur gyi dri mas driṃ maṃ can du byas pa niṃ/ bdag med rtogs pa'i yeṃ shesaṃ kyi meṃ yiṃs nyonaṃ moṃngs mtha' dag bsregaṃs la/ ye shes deṃ nyidaṃ kyis 'odaṃ gsalaṃ ba yi sems kyi rang bzhin ni bsregs pa maṃ yiṃn te gnas lugs rang gi yin noṃ// 'o na rtsub stan dang rtsub shing mnyam du zad pa ltar spang gnyen mnyam zad ma yin nam/ sher phyin gyi mdo las kyang*/ chos thams cad bkag par mdzad pas lung dang yang 'gal lo zhe na/

skyon med de chos thams cad rang bzhin med pa stongaṃ paṃ nyidaṃ niṃ gsal bar stonaṃ pa'iṃ mdoṃ sher phyin sogs/ rgyalaṃ bsaṃ jiṃ snyedaṃ mang du gsungaṃs paṃ gangaṃ yin pa/ deṃ dgaṃ kunaṃ gyisaṃ kyang 'khrul snang gi nyonaṃ moṃngs mtha' dag ldog giṃ des na 'khor lo bar par stong nyid spros bral gyi lung gsungs pa thams cad bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i chos kyi gnas lugs khamasaṃ deṃ ni nyaṃms paraṃ byedaṃ pa'am spang byar bstan pa maṃ yinaṃ gyi skye 'gags gnas gsum sogs 'dus byas kyi mtshan nyid kyis dben pa tsam ston pa'i phyir ro// de'ang mtha' bral ston pa'i dbu ma'i rigs pas 'khrul snang ldog pa'i gnyen po tsam byed mod don la spang gnyen gnyis char brdzun pa (20) yin te/ rtsod bzlog las/ dgag bya ci yang med pas na// ngas ni ci yang mi 'gog go /de phyir dgag par byed do zhes// bskur pa de ni khyod kyis btab// zhes dang*/ spyod 'jug las/ ji lta rmi lam bu shi la// de med snyam pa'i rnam rtog ni// de yod rnam par rtog pa yi// gegs yin de yang brdzun pa yin// zhes so// des na spang gnyen gnyis char mnyam du med par 'gyur bas gnas lugs cang med ci phyir mi 'gyur snyam na/ rmi lam gyi skye shi gnyis brdzun par ston gyi/ sad pa'i snang ba brdzun par ston pa min no// dpe de bzhin du 'khrul pa'i blo ngor snang ba'i dgag sgrub mtha' dag dgag bya rang bzhin gyis grub ma myong ba des na brdzun par ston gyi/ gnas gyur pas 'khrul snang zad pa'i bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ye shes med par ston pa ga la yin/ gzhan du rdzogs sangs sku ni 'phro phyir dang*// de bzhin nyid dbyer med phyir dang*// rigs yod phyir na lus can kun// rtag tu sangs rgyas snying po can// zhes dang*/ sems kyi rang bzhin 'od gsal zhing*// dri ma rnams ni glo bur ba// zhes dang*/ brtag gnyis las/

sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid// 'on kyang glo bur dri mas bsgribs// dri ma de bsal sangs rgyas dngos// zhes sogs nges don gyi mdo rgyud dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa las/ khams kyi yon tan bshad pa kun ri rwa'i bshad pa bzhin don med (21) du 'gyur te khams dang dri ma gnyis ka glo bur ba 'dra ba'i phyir ro// de ni gdul bya'i spro ba bskyed pa'i yan lag tsam yin no snyam na/ de lta gnas skabs spro ba tsam skye mod/ gnas lugs cang med yin na/ mthar de ngo sprad dgos pas de dus yi pham kyang bskyed pa'i phyir brtag na bzhad gad gyi gnas so// des na spang gnyen gnyis char med par bstan pa ni blos byas yod med kyi 'dzin stangs stong pa'i don yin gyi blo 'das chos sku med par ston pa min no// 'o na bden grub yod pa zhig yin nam snyam na/ bden grub lta ci bden med kyang yod par mi 'dod de/ yod med bden rdzun sogs gang ltar khas len yang rigs pa'i gnod byed yod de/ de dag phan tshun ltos grub yin pas gang yang khas len du mi btub ste spros bral yin pas so// de skad do ha las/ yod par 'dzin pa phyugs dang 'dra ba ste// med par 'dzin pa de bas kyang ni blun// zhes so// des na so skye'i blos dmus long gi glang chen ltar gnas lugs ji lta ba bzhin gzhal mi nus pas gsal ba'am stong pa rtsal ston phyogs re la de kho na ltar zhen par mi bya ste/ bden gnyis dbyer med rnam grangs min pa'i don bde gshegs snying po ni rtog ge bas (22) dpyad sgom gyis go yul tsam las ji bzhin rtogs mi srid la/ rnal 'byor pas spros bral 'jog sgom gyi rtogs bya yin no// gal te khams kyang med pa yin na mthar thug gi 'bras bu cang med du rgyang 'phen pa'i 'dod pa ltar du 'gyur bas lam bsgrubs pa don med 'gyur zhing*/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas med pas phrin las rgyun chad pa sogs skyon mang por 'bab bo// des na sa bon 'gag nas myu gu skye ba dang mi 'dra'o// 'dis ni lam gyi gnas skabs su dri ma zad par byed pa tsam yin gyi khams 'phel 'grib med par bstan pa'o// yang dpe ji ltar na sa yi dkyil na yod pa'i chu ni ngo bo la sa yi dri ma med par dwangs bar gnas pa ltar/

glo bur ba'i nyon mongs nang na ngo bo ye dag gi ye shes kyang*/ de bzhin dri ma med par gdod nas gnas pa de lam gyi dri ma sbyang stobs kyis mngon du gyur pa tsam yin gyi sngar med gsar skye ma yin te chos nyid 'phel 'grib mi rung ba'i phyir ro// des na yon tan gsar du bsnan pa med cing dri ma glo bur tsam las ngo bo bsal du med de/ rgyud bla ma las/ 'di la bsam bya ci yang med// bzhag par bya ba cung zad med// yang dag nyid la yang dag lta// yang dag mthong na rnam par grol// zhes pa (23) ltar 'dis ni 'bras bu'i gnas skabs su sngar gyi rang bzhin mngon du gyur pa tsam las gsar skye med par bstan to// des na sa bon las myu gu gsar du skye ba dang mi 'dra'o// gnyis pa glo bur ba'i dri ma don la ma grub par bshad pa la'ang gnyis/ dri ma ma grub pa'i tshul dang*/ des na de sbyong byed lam sgrub tshul lo// dang po la'ang gsum/ 'khrul pa don la ma grub par bstan/ thabs shes gnyis dang ldan na de nyid grol rkyen du 'gyur tshul/ des na 'khor 'das 'ching grol 'thad pa'o// dang po la'ang gsum/ 'khor ba snang la rang bzhin med par bstan/ myang 'das kyang tha snyad du khas len dgos kyang gzung 'dzin gyi ngo bo ma grub par bstan/ des na 'khor 'das dbu ma'i lam du don gcig par bstan pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ rgyas bshad dang don bsdu'o// dang po la gsum/ bdag dang bdag gi don la med kyang tha snyad du snang rung ba dang*/ de nyid gnyen po lam gyis sbyang tshul/ gnas lugs don la grub kyang dri bcas kyi skabs su mi mthong ba'i 'thad pa dpes bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'o na tha mal pa'i gnas skabs na yang chos nyid yod na de bdag dang bdag gir 'dzin yul yin no snyam na/ ma yin te/ chosaṃ dbyiṃngs ni rgyu mtshan (24) gangaṃ gi phyiraṃ bdagaṃ maṃ yinaṃ la/ budaṃ medaṃ maṃ yinaṃ skyesaṃ paṃ'angaṃ miṃn te bdag dang bdag gi ba'i 'khor ba don la grub ma myong ba yin no// de gnas lugs gzungaṃ baṃ dang 'dzin pa kunaṃ lasaṃ rnamaṃ par grolaṃ baṃ chos dbyings de/

jiṃ ltaṃr gzung 'dzin gyi rang bzhin bdagaṃ ceṃs brtagaṃ paraṃ byaṃ ste dngos 'gal yin pa'i phyir snang ba la mun par brjod mi rung ba ltar ro// don gyi gnas lugs 'khor gsum gyi chaṃgs paṃ meṃd paṃ'i choṃs rnams kunaṃ laṃ budaṃ meṃd dang skyesaṃ paṃ zhes dmigaṃs pa maṃ yiṃn no// de'ang*/ spyod 'jug las/ de ltar rmi lam lta bu yi// gzugs la dpyod ldan su zhig chags// des na skyes pa bud med gang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// 'o na 'jig rten gyi mngon sum dang 'gal zhing lung las kyang tha snyad kyi rnam bzhag mang du 'byung ba de ci zhe na/ 'dodaṃ chaṃgs kyisaṃ chos dbyings mthong ba'i shes rab kyi mig ldangaṃ ba'i gdulaṃ byaṃ rmongs pa de dag 'dul ba'iṃ phyiraṃ du/ budaṃ medaṃ dang*/ skyesaṃ paṃ zhesaṃ sogs tha snyad kyi rnam bzhag sems kyi ngor mdzad nas raṃb tu mang po bstanaṃ pa yin te/ de skad du gang 'jig rten yod par 'dod pa de nged kyang yod par 'dod do zhes sogs gsung pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa de lta bu 'khor ba'i 'khrul snang glo bur ba de sbyang ba'i tshul ni miṃ rtagaṃ pa dang sdugaṃ bsngalaṃ ba dang stongaṃ

(25) paṃ zhesaṃ byaṃ baṃ rnam pa gsumaṃ posaṃ ni semaṃs sbyongaṃ byedaṃ thog mar sngon 'gro lta bu nyon mongs mgo gnon tsam yin gyi/ dngos gnyen mchoṃg tuṃ semaṃs niṃ sbyongaṃ byedaṃ pa'iṃ/ gnyen po chosaṃ thams cad niṃ rangaṃ bzhinaṃ medaṃ paṃ bdag med rnam pa gnyis yiṃn no// gsum pa ni/ glo bur gyi dri ma don la ma grub na lam sgom pa don med de/ chos dbyings gdod nas 'pho med du gnas pa'i phyir thams cad kyis mthong bar thal zhe na/ dpe jiṃ ltaraṃ na sbrumaṃ maṃ dman pa'i ltoṃ ba naṃ sa bdag 'khor bsgyur buṃ/ yodaṃ kyangaṃ gnas skabs mngal las ma grol bar mthoṃng baṃ maṃ yinaṃ paṃ/ deṃ bzhiṃn don la ma grub pa glo bur ba'i nyonaṃ moṃngs kyisaṃ g.yoṃgs pa'iṃ/ chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs sems can la 'bral med du yod kyangaṃ mthongaṃ ba maṃ yiṃn no// gnyis pa don bsdu ba ni/ nges na bdagaṃ tu 'dzin pa dngaṃ*/ bdagaṃ giraṃ 'dzin pa'i rnamaṃ rtogaṃ gnyisaṃ/ ka bum lta bu mingaṃ giṃ rnam rtog dang*/ ming der 'duṃ shesaṃ pa'i mtshanaṃ donaṃ gyisaṃ/ rnamaṃ par rtogaṃ na ste bzhiṃ poṃ tha snyad du 'byungaṃ baṃ yaṃng*/ gtso bo 'byungaṃ bzhi dngaṃ 'byuṃng ba laṃs gyuraṃ pa bcu gcig dang gzugs phung rag phyir phal cher gyis bdag tu 'dzin paṃs soṃ// de yang dpyad na ma grub ste/ rigs pa drug cu pa las/ 'byung ba che la sogs bshad pa// rnam par (26) shes la yang dag 'du// de shes pas ni 'bral gyur na// log pa rnam brtag ma yin no// zhes dang*/ dbyig gnyen gyis/ drug gis gcig char sbyar ba na// phra rab rdul cha drug tu 'gyur// zhes gsungs so// 'di ni rag phyir mtshon pa tsam ste gzung 'dzin 'khrul snang yod do cog glo bur byung ba tsam yin gyi don la ma grub ces so// gnyis pa ni/ 'khor ba don la ma grub mod mya ngan las 'das pa'i rang bzhin sangs rgyas nges par yod la de yod pas/

des gdul zhing 'khor ba'ang yod do snyam na/ myang 'das don la grub pa tha snyad tsam du khas len dgos mod/ 'on kyang gzung 'dzin gyi ngo bo khas len mi btub ste 'khor ba dang khyad par med pa'i phyir/ des na tha snyad tsam las gnas lugs la 'khor 'das kyi spros pa dben la myang 'das kyang gzung 'dzin gyi ngo bo ma grub par bstan pa ni/ saṃngs rgyasaṃ rnaṃms kyiṃ smoṃn laṃm stobs kyis gzugs sku'i snang ba yaṃng*/ snaṃng baṃ rang mtshan pa medaṃ cingaṃ mtshaṃn nyiṃd du grub pa cung zad kyang medaṃ do// 'on kyang sangs rgyas kyi smon lam dang gdul bya'i dkar po dge ba 'joms pa las snang ste chu zla bzhin no// (27) gzugs sku gnyis kyang gzhan snang kho nar 'dod na ni mi rung ste nam mkha'i zla ba med par chu zla mi srid pa bzhin bdag rkyen sangs rgyas med na sems can la ci zhig snang ste snang du mi rung*/ sangs rgyas sku gsum gyi bdag nyid du yang mi rung ngo*// soṃ soṃ rangaṃ gis rigaṃ pa'i sbyoraṃ ba ldanaṃ pa smra bsam brjod pa dang bral ba nyidaṃ de/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ni 'dus ma byas rtagaṃ pa'iṃ choṃs nyiṃd canaṃ yinaṃ pas de ni gzung 'dzin las 'das pa yin noṃ// de yang chos sku rang bzhin gyi rtag pa dang longs sku rgyun gyi rtag pa dang*/ sprul sku rgyun mi chad pa'i tshul gyi rtag pa'i brda' sbyar yang rtag dngos khas len mi rung ngo*// gsum pa des na 'khor 'das dbu ma'i lam du ro gcig par bstan pa la gnyis/ gnas lugs don la 'khor 'das dbyer med bstan/ tha snyad tsam du 'khor 'das so sor 'ching ba'i tshul bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dpe jiṃ ltaraṃ na riṃ boṃng gis mgoṃ yiṃ raṃ/ blos ming rkyang la brtaṃgs paṃ nyiṃd deṃ don la meṃd paṃ 'jig rten na grags pa ltaṃr/ deṃ bzhiṃn 'dus byas 'dus ma byas kyi 'khor ba dang myang 'das sogs choṃs rnaṃms thamaṃs caṃd kyaṃng*/

'khrul blos brtaṃgs paṃ tsam nyidaṃ deṃ rang bzhin rdul tsam yoṃd pa maṃ yiṃn no// phraṃ raṃb rdulaṃ gyiṃ ngoṃ boṃ phan tshun 'phrad ma (28) 'phrad dpyad pa'i rigs pa yiṃs/ dpyad na 'jig rten na yod par grags pa'i glangaṃ giṃ rwaṃ yaṃng don la dmiṃgs pa maṃ yinaṃ te ri rwa bzhin no// de bzhin dngos po kun la sbyar ro// dpyad na ma grub pas 'o na gnas lugs chos sku yang blos sgro btags su 'gyur ro snyam na yod med du zhen na bden yang 'dzin pa zhig pas mi 'dra ste/ jiṃ ltaṃr sngoṃn dri bcas kyi skabs bzhiṃn phyiṃs dri med kyi gnas skabs su yang deṃ bzhinaṃ te chos nyid don dam bden pa yin pa'i phyir ngo bo la bzang ngan du rtog pa med do// des na chos nyid gzung 'dzin las grol ba deṃ laṃ ciṃ zhiṃg blos sgro btagaṃs paṃr byaṃ ste spros pa'i yul ma yin pa'i phyir ro// 'khrul snang mtha' dag rang mtshan ma grub pas tha snyad tsam du rgyu rkyen la brteṃn naṃs 'byuṃng b.raṃ 'gyuraṃ baṃ dngaṃ*/ brtenaṃ naṃs 'gaṃg paraṃ 'gyuraṃ bsaṃ naṃ/ skye 'gag sogs dngos po rang mtshan grub pa gciṃg kyangaṃ yodaṃ paṃ maṃ yinaṃ naṃ/ byiṃs paṃ rnams kyis jiṃ ltaṃr rang mtshan zhig rtoṃgs paṃr byedaṃ de rang mtshan pa mthong ba ma yin no// smos ma thag pa ltar 'jig rten na med par grags pa riṃ bong gi rwa dang*/ yod par grags pa glaṃng giṃ rwaṃ yiṃ dpeṃs/ jiṃ ltaṃr na bdeṃ baṃr gsheṃgs pa'iṃ 'khor 'das kyi choṃs rnaṃms nyiṃd thams cad/ mtha' bral (29) dbu ma zung 'jug mnyam pa nyid du sgrub par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ 'o na kun rdzob 'khor 'das ji ltar snang bar 'gyur zhe na/ 'di ltar snang ba'i chos thams cad gdod nas skye ba med cing bden par ma grub pas don dam du bden pa min la sems kyi rang rtsal 'gag med so sor snang bas 'khrul ngor brdzun pa'ang min te/ dpe jiṃ ltaṃr na nyiṃ zlaṃ dang skaṃr ma'iṃ gzuṃgs ma 'dres pa so sor/

dngaṃ ba'iṃ snoṃd kyiṃ chuṃ yi naṃng duṃ/ gzuṃgs brnyaṃn mthoṃng b.raṃ gyuraṃ paṃ na zla ba sogs snang dus nas rang mtshan yod ma myong ba dang*/ zla ba sogs med bzhin du zla ba'i gzugs dang kha dog snang ba tsam ma 'gags pa zla snang dang stong pa gnyis dbyer mi phyed cing chu zla'i mtshan nyid stong par shes na zla 'dzin rang sar grol ba ltar/ kun rdzob tu 'khor 'das kyi mtshan nyid kyang ma 'dres par so sor rdzogs shing snang dus nyid nas bden par yod ma myong ba dang*/ bden par med bzhin du snang tsam ma 'gags par snang ba ste/ des na snang stong dbyer mi phyed pa dang mtshanaṃ nyidaṃ stong par shes na snang bar 'dzin pa rang sar grol bas chos nyid rtogaṃs paṃ'angaṃ dpe deṃ dngaṃ 'dra'oṃ// 'o na snang cha de la bdag dang bdag gir lta ba'i gzung 'dzin rang mtshan pa ci phyir mi 'gyur te snang ba yod pa'i phyir/ des na glo bur ba yi grub bo snyam na snang ba (30) la/ snang bar 'dzin pa bden yang 'dzin pa mtha' dag zhig pa'i phyir nyes pa med de/ thogaṃ maṃ gzhi yi gnas skabs dang*/ b.raṃ maṃ lam dang*/ mtharaṃ 'bras bu ste/ gnas skabs gsum du dgeṃ baṃ gzung 'dzin grub ma myong ba rnams kyang bslu baṃ meṃd ciṃng bstanaṃ paṃ yiṃ chos rnams kyi rang bzhin gaṃng zhiṃg deṃ ltaraṃ bdagaṃ meṃd paṃ'angaṃ jiṃ ltaṃr na bdaṃg dngaṃ bdagaṃ giṃr brtagaṃ ste dpyad na rdul tsam yang ma grub pa'i phyir ro// 'o na chos rnams kyi rang bzhin dbyer med yin na sems can dang sangs rgyas kyi gnas skabs gnyis mi srid par 'gyur snyam na skyon med de/ jiṃ ltaṃr soṃ gaṃ'i dusaṃ suṃ chuṃ de nyid tshad pa'i stobs kyis drosaṃ soṃ zhesaṃ niṃ brjodaṃ paraṃ byedaṃ cing*/ chu gcig pu deṃ nyidaṃ dgun lta bu graṃng ba'iṃ dusaṃ suṃ niṃ/ grangaṃ ngoṃ zhesaṃ niṃ brjodaṃ paṃ yinaṃ pa de tshe la las chu yi rang bzhin khyad par med pa dpe de bzhin du chos dbyings de nyid nyonaṃ moṃngs pa'i draṃ bsaṃ g.yoṃg paṃ na niṃ/

semaṃs canaṃ zhesaṃ niṃ brjoṃd paṃr byaṃ zhing*/ rang bzhin deṃ nyiṃd glo bur gyi nyonaṃ moṃngs dang bralaṃ bar gyuraṃ pa naṃ/ dag pa gnyis ldan gyi sangasaṃ rgyasaṃ zhesaṃ niṃ brjodaṃ paraṃ byaṃ ba tsam yin no// gnyis pa thabs shes gnyis dang ldan pa de nyid grol rkyen 'gyur ba la gnyis/ dpyad nas tshogs drug yul snang dang bcas pa rang grol (31) du 'gyur ba gom pa de nyid rtogs pa mngon du gyur na don dam pa'i mtshan nyid tshang bar bstan pa'o// dang po ni/ 'o na 'khor ba gzung 'dzin yul yul can du grub pa dang*/ myang 'das de las grol ba gnyis chu dro grang ltar ngo bo gcig tu grub pa mi 'thad do snyam na/ rnal 'byor pas legs par dpyad pa na/ snang bzhin pa 'di stong pa nyid yin pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid kyi ngo bor grub ste/ bdag rkyen miṃg dbang dngaṃ*/ dmigs rkyen gzuṃgs sogs laṃ brtenaṃ nasaṃ niṃ/ dpyad pa btang ba'i ngor driṃ maṃ medaṃ pa'iṃ gzugaṃs shesaṃ kyiṃ snangaṃ baṃ 'byung ba ni/ dpyad na rten 'brel gyi ngo bo stong nyid skyeṃ ba medaṃ cing 'gagaṃ paṃ medaṃ pa nyid du grub pa las chos kyi dbyings ni rab tu shes so// de bzhin du chos kyi dbyings stong nyid ston pa'i slob dpon gyi ngag sgraṃ dngaṃ*/ rnaṃ baṃ laṃ/ brtenaṃ nasaṃ ma 'khrul ba rnamaṃ paraṃ dgaṃ pa'iṃ sheṃs paṃ dang bcas pa gsumaṃ gyi stobs las mtshanaṃ nyiṃd medaṃ paṃ'i choṃs kyiṃ dbyiṃngs stong pa nyid kyi don rtogaṃ bcas yid kyi shes pa dngaṃ bcasaṃ pasaṃ thosaṃ paraṃ 'gyuraṃ ba las/ bsam byung dang sgom byung rim gyis skye bar 'gyur ro// yang snaṃ yi dbang po dngaṃ*/ dmigs rkyen driṃ laṃ brteṃn naṃs snomaṃ pa'i blo skye ba deṃ niṃ gzuṃgs suṃ grub pa medaṃ pa'iṃ dpeṃs/ gzung ba mtha' dag drug gis (32) gcig char sbyar ba'i rigs pas ma grub par ston nus shing*/ gzung ba med na 'dzin pa med pas snga ma deṃ bzhiṃn du snaṃ yiṃ rnaṃm sheṃs kyiṃs kyang chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs laṃ rtogaṃs paraṃ byedaṃ pa'i grogs byed do// de bzhin du lceṃ yiṃ dbang po dpyad gzhi byas nas gcig du bral dang mtha' bzhi'i skye ba 'gog pa'i rim pas rangaṃ bzhinaṃ stoṃng pa nyiṃd du rtogs shing roṃ yiṃ khamasaṃ kyangaṃ de bzhin du dbeṃn paṃ steṃ/

stong nyid chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs kyiṃ ngoṃ boṃ yinaṃ no// lus kyi rnamaṃ paraṃ shesaṃ paṃ phyi nang gang du yang gnaṃs shing grubaṃ pa medaṃ pa dgaṃ pa'iṃ lusaṃ kyiṃ ngoṃ boṃ dngaṃ*/ regaṃ paraṃ byaṃ ba'iṃ yul dmigs rkyen gyi mtshanaṃ nyiṃd dngaṃ bcas pa ni/ don du rkyenaṃ dang rkyen caṃn lasaṃ niṃ grolaṃ bar 'gyuraṃ baṃ chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyingaṃs kyi rang bzhin zhesaṃ brjoṃd paṃr bya'oṃ// yiṃd kyi rnam shes gtsoṃ bor gyuraṃ pa'iṃ chosaṃ rnaṃms thams cad laṃ rtogaṃ pa po blo dang*/ brtagaṃ paraṃ byaṃ ba'iṃ yulaṃ gyi spros pa rnams spangaṃ nasaṃ spros bral gyi ngang du dpyad pa btang ste rtsol med du bzhag nas chosaṃ rnaṃms raṃng bzhinaṃ meṃd paṃ stong pa nyiṃd chosaṃ kyiṃ dbyiṃngs suṃ bsgoṃm paṃr bya'oṃ// gnyis pa ni/ de ltar gom pa las mthongaṃ ba gzugs dngaṃ thosaṃ pas sgra dngaṃ bsnoṃm paṃ dri dngaṃ myangaṃ ba ro dngaṃ regaṃ paraṃ gyuraṃ paṃ reg bya dngaṃ shes par bya ba chosaṃ khams rnamasaṃ ni rang bzhin med pa/ (33) deṃ ltaraṃ rnaṃl 'byoṃr pasaṃ mngon sum du shesaṃ naṃs sgom pa'i don dam pa'i mtshaṃn nyiṃd rdzogaṃs paṃ yinaṃ no// de bzhin du migaṃ dngaṃ rnaṃ baṃ dang snaṃ dgaṃ dngaṃ*/ lceṃ dngaṃ luṃs daṃng deṃ bzhiṃn du yiṃd dang bcas pa'i skyeṃ mcheṃd drugaṃ poṃ rangaṃ bzhiṃn gyisaṃ spros pa'i mtshan ma rnamaṃ paraṃ dgaṃ paṃ mngoṃn sum du rtogasaṃ paṃ 'diṃ nyidaṃ kho na deṃ kho na nyidaṃ kyi mtshaṃn nyiṃd doṃ// gsum pa 'khor 'das 'ching grol 'thad pa la gsum/ 'ching grol byed tshul mdor bstan pa/ theg pa mchog dman gyi grol tshul bye brag tu bshad pa/ 'ching grol kun rtog tsam las don la ma grub pas rtog med la goms dgos par gdam pa'o// dang po ni/ semaṃs nyiṃd ngo bo la bzang ngan med kyang glo bur ba'i dri ma dag ma dag gi khyad par gyis rnamaṃ paṃ gnyiṃs suṃ mthoṃng ste/ tshul jiṃ ltaṃr na 'jigaṃ rtenaṃ pa dang 'jigaṃ rtenaṃ las 'dasaṃ pa gnyis rim pa bzhin/

'jig rten pas bdagaṃ tuṃ 'dzinaṃ pa laṃs 'khoraṃ baṃ 'byung steṃ/ de nyid bdag med rtogs shing soṃ soraṃ rang rigaṃ pa naṃ deṃ kho na nyiṃd kyi mtshan nyid doṃ// gnyis pa ni/ rnal 'byor pa gang zag gi bdag med dang gzung ba chos kyi bdag med rtogs na 'dodaṃ chaṃgs zadaṃ paṃs nyan rang gi lhag bcas lhag med kyi myaṃ nganaṃ las 'dasaṃ pa 'thob ste der ma zad zheṃ sdaṃng dang gtiṃ mugaṃ kyang nyon sgrib kyi (34) cha zaṃd dgos paṃ dngaṃ*/ rang rgyal la ni shes sgrib gzung rtog kyang spang dgos so// theg chen pas bdag med gnyis rtogs nas sgrib gnyis deṃ dgaṃ ma lus pa 'gaṃgs paṃ na sangasaṃ rgyasaṃ nyidaṃ 'thob cing lusaṃ caṃn kunaṃ gyiṃ mthar thug gi skyabaṃs nyag gcig nyidaṃ doṃ// 'o na nyan rang gi mthar thug gi skyabs sangs rgyas tshol dgos na theg chen du lam gang nas 'jug snyam na tshogs lam nas 'jug dgos te theg chen gyi lam lnga rjes su 'gro ldog nges dgos pas so// gsum pa ni/ gnas lugs shesaṃ pa dngaṃ miṃ shesaṃ paṃ dgaṃ gi khyad par laṃs lus dang*/ ngag dang bas sems 'di nyid la 'khor 'das kyi bag chags dbang gis thams cad snang ba nyid de/ de'ang gnas lugs ma rtog pa rnams kyis raṃng giṃ lus ngag yid gsum la rnamaṃ paraṃ rtogaṃ pasaṃ gzung 'dzin rang mtshan par zhen te 'khor bar rang nyid bciṃngs la gnas lugs rtogs pa'i rnal 'byor pas lus ngag yid gsum gyi bdagaṃ nyidaṃ dam rang bzhin gnas lugs bdag med kyi don mngon par shesaṃ naṃ gzung 'dzin 'khor ba las grolaṃ te sangs rgyas sku gsum thob nas sgrib gnyis kyi dri ma spang baṃr 'gyuraṃ ro// lus ni mtshon pa tsam ste ngag dang yid gnyis kyang go dgos te 'phags pa thog med kyis/ gzugs kyi phung po gnas gyur pa'i phyir/ zhing dang lus dang mtshan dang dpe byad bzang po dang dbyangs mtha' yas pa dang spyi gtsug (35) gi bltar mi mngon pa la dbang 'byor ba dang*/

zhes gsungs so// byangaṃ chubaṃ ni so skye la riṃng ba minaṃ cing 'phags pa la nyeṃ ba'aṃng miṃn la/ lam sgrub pa po myang 'das kyi sar 'groṃ baṃ miṃn laṃ byang chub de tshur 'oṃng baṃ minaṃ cing glo bur gyi nyonaṃ moṃngs kyi gzebaṃ tu gyuraṃ pa sems rang bzhin chos dbyings 'diṃ nyiṃd laṃ 'phags pas mthoṃng ba dngaṃ ni so skyes maṃ mthoṃng ba tsamaṃ yinaṃ gyiṃ/ byang chub kyi ngo bo la mchog dman dang 'phel 'grib sogs ma grub bo// des na blo dang ldan pa rnams kyis thos bsam sgom gsum gyi shesaṃ raṃb bdag 'dzin gyi mun pa sel ba'i maraṃ meṃ lta bu laṃ gnasaṃ pa'am brten nasaṃ yod med sogs mchoṃg tuṃ spros pa mtha' dag nye bar zhiṃ baṃr gyuraṃ paṃ yiṃ ye shes kyis don la grub ma myong bas bdagaṃ laṃ brtagaṃ cing dpyad pasaṃ rang bzhin ma grub pa'i tshul la gnaṃs par byaṃ zhesaṃ bde bar gshegs pas mdoṃ sdeṃ'i tshoṃgs laṃs rgya cher gsungasaṃ paṃ laṃgs so// 'dir mchog tu zhi ba zhes pa'i don ni/ nyan rang gis chos thams cad sgyu ma lta bu bden med rtogs pas yod pa 'gog pa tsam yin yang*/ byang sems kyis yod med sogs spros pa mtha' dag bral ba sgom dgos te med dgag tsam phyogs re'i lta bas sangs rgyas mi thob ste/ rgyu ma tshang ba'i 'bras bu bzhin no zhes pa'i don to//

(36) gnyis pa dri ma spang ba'i lam sgrub tshul la gnyis/ bdag rkyen sangs rgyas kyi bzhugs tshul/ de la brten nas lam sgom tshul lo// dang po la gnyis/ gzugs sku'i bzhugs tshul dang*/ chos sku'i bzhugs tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ phrin las 'jug tshul spyir bstan pa/ skal dman la mi 'jug cing skal ldan la 'jug tshul gyi 'thad pa bye brag tu bshad/ des na bcom ldan 'das la nye ring mi mnga' ba'o// dang po ni/ stobasaṃ bcuṃ mngaṃ' ba'iṃ saṃngs rgyasaṃ kyiṃ stobaṃs kyiṃ phriṃn lasaṃ byisaṃ paṃ rnamasaṃ la byiṃn rlabaṃs 'byung tshul ni/ gdul bya'i sems kyi dri ma dag rim bzhin gyis 'phel ba ni/ dper na zlaṃ baṃ tshesaṃ paṃ bzhinaṃ no// gnyis pa ni/ nyonaṃ moṃngs caṃn gyiṃ dri ma ma spang ba'i semaṃs can gyisaṃ deṃ bzhinaṃ gsheṃgs paṃ nam yang miṃ mthoṃng ngoṃ*// dpe jiṃ ltaṃr na yiṃ dwagasaṃ rnamasaṃ kyisaṃ niṃ ser sna'i sgrib pa'i dbang gis rgyaṃ mtshoṃ chen po yang skamaṃ paṃr mthoṃng baṃ ltaraṃ/ deṃ bzhinaṃ miṃ shesaṃ paṃ las nyon gyis sgribaṃ pasaṃ na sangaṃs rgyasaṃ rnamasaṃ niṃ/ gtan nas medaṃ paraṃ brtagaṃs te sems so// 'o na bcom ldan 'das ni mkhyen rab dang thugs rje la mnga' brnyes pas 'gro ba mchog dman kun la phrin las ci'i phyir mi 'jug snyam na/ brtson 'grus dang shes rab dman pas (37) rigs dman pa dang*/ sngon bsags bsoṃd namaṃs dmaṃn pa rnams laṃ bcoṃm ldanaṃ 'das kyisaṃ ciṃ bgyir mchisaṃ te jiṃ ltaṃr skyes tsam nas mig gtan nas med pa'i rmusaṃ loṃng gi laṃg pa ruṃ riṃn chenaṃ mchogaṃ rin thang med pa zhig niṃ bzhagaṃ paṃ na/ de la lta ba'i go skabs med pa dang 'dra'oṃ// seṃms canaṃ mchog sngon chad bsoṃd naṃms byasaṃ pa rnamasaṃ laṃ ni/ yid bzhin gyi nor bu kun gyis bskrun du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi rtag khyab lhun grub kyi phrin las 'byung ba'i yid bzhin nor bu'i 'oṃd kyiṃs gsalaṃ zhiṃng don gnyis 'grub pa'i dpalaṃ dang ldanaṃ paṃ'i sumaṃ cuṃ rtsaṃ gnyiṃs kyis mtshanaṃ dang dpe byad brgyad cu'i 'od 'baṃr baṃ/

saṃngs rgyasaṃ ni bsod nams can deṃ yiṃ mdunaṃ naṃ gnaṃs shing*/ gsum pa ni/ mgonaṃ poṃ deṃ yiṃ mdun na gzuṃgs kyiṃ skusaṃ bskalaṃ paṃ grangs med pa mngaṃ poṃr longs sku dang sprul sku'i zhing khams na bzhuṃgs nasaṃ kyangaṃ*/ gdulaṃ byaṃ rnamaṃs niṃ gdulaṃ ba'iṃ phyiraṃ chos kyi dbyiṃngs dbyer med pa nyidaṃ bde bar gshegs pa'i thabs dang gdul bya'i bsam pa'i dbang gi gzugs sku gnyis po re re'ang sku gsung thugs kyi bkod pa mi 'dra ba sna tshogs pa bsam gyis mi khyab par snang ba/ ngo bo la gcig dang thaṃ dadaṃ bsam duṃ med kyang*/ snang tshul mi 'dra ba tha dad du gyuraṃ pa laṃgs so// rgyal tshab byams pas/ ji ltar tshon gyi sna tshogs (38) kyi// nor bu de dngos min par snang*// de bzhin 'gro rkyen sna tshogs kyi// khyab bdag de dngos min par snang*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gnyis pa la gnyis/ chos sku mngon du byed tshul/ de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi rang bzhin du bstan pa'o// dang po chos sku mngon du gyur tshul ni/ semaṃs kyiṃ yulaṃ lam gnas lugs niṃ ngeṃs par rtogaṃs naṃs yul chos kyi dbyings deraṃ niṃ bdag med rtogs pa'i shesaṃ paṃ 'jugaṃ paraṃ gyuraṃ te/ soṃ soṃ rangaṃ rigaṃ pa'i ye shes mchog tu rnamaṃ par dgaṃ ste mthar thug naṃ/ saṃ rnamasaṃ mtha' dag deṃ yiṃ bdagaṃ nyidaṃ du gnasaṃ te mthar phyin pa yin no// gnas gang du zhe na/ dbaṃng phyugaṃ chenaṃ po'iṃ ste sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyi bskor ba sangs rgyas longs sku'i gnasaṃ mchogaṃ dngaṃ*/ yang na ming gi rnam grangs gzhan 'ogaṃ miṃn gyi zhing khams nyidaṃ deṃ rnamaṃ par mdzeṃs paṃ zhes bya ba der rgyun mtha'i byang chub sems dpa' des rdor ting gi de ma thag tu bya byed las gsum gyi shesaṃ paṃ gsumaṃ poṃ 'khor gsum mi dmigs pa ro gcigaṃ nyidaṃ duṃ mnyam rjes 'dresaṃ paṃr gyuraṃ pa laṃ chos sku'i rtogs pa mthar phyin pa zhes bstan bcos brtsam pa po bdagaṃ smraṃ 'oṃ// de'ang 'jug pa las/

sems 'gag pa de sku yi mngon sum mdzad// ces gsungs pa ltar ro// de yang mthong lam thob na bden 'dzin dang*/ dag pa na (39) mtshan 'dzin dang*/ sangs rgyas pa na gnyis snang gis 'khor gsum rnam rtog mtha' dag 'gog go /gnyis pa ni/ 'o na chos sku'i bzhugs tshul ji lta bu zhe na/ byisaṃ pa'iṃ nangaṃ naṃ shes bya yoṃngs su mkhyenaṃ pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs paṃ ste/ so skye ni chos sku mngon sum du byed pa'i tshul gyis ma rtogs la des na chos sku'i mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyis khyab pa'i rang bzhin gyi tshul gyis gnas pa dang zhes pa'i don to// 'phagaṃs paṃ'i naṃng naṃ ni snaṃ tshoṃgs nyiṃd de nyan rang gang zag dang*/ gzung ba chos kyi bdag med mngon sum du rtogs pa dang*/ byang 'phags dang sangs rgyas 'phags pas gzung 'dzin gyi spros pa mtha' dag bral ba mngon sum dang phyogs tsam dang*/ mtha' dag rtogs pa'i tshul du bzhugs so// dag pa gnyis ldan gyi chos sku dri bral de ni dbaṃng phyugaṃ chenaṃ poṃ longs sku yi rang bzhin tshe dpaṃg tu meṃd paṃ bskalaṃ paṃ ni bar du gnas pa'i tsheṃ yiṃ rgyuṃ gaṃng yiṃn pa de yang de nyid do// nang gi dri bral chos kyi sku ma rtogs pas phyiṃ rolaṃ semaṃs caṃn khamasaṃ kyiṃ yangaṃ*/ dus dpaṃg tu meṃd pa'iṃ bskalaṃ paraṃ niṃ/ gnas pa'i tsheṃ yaṃng dri bcas chos kyi sku gaṃng giṃ bsrungaṃ bar gyuraṃ cingaṃ*/ dri bcas chos dbyings de ni srogaṃ chaṃgs rnamasaṃ kyiṃ srogaṃ gnaṃs pa'iṃ/ rgyuṃ gaṃng yin pa miṃ zadaṃ paṃ deṃ nyidaṃ do// (40) 'dis mdor na dri bcas dri med kyi chos sku skye 'chi sogs 'pho 'gyur bral ba de nyid 'khor 'das kun gyi rang bzhin nam ngo bo nyid srog gi bdag nyid bstan to// gnyis pa la gnyis/ lam bgrod tshul rim pa spyir bstan/ theg pa chen po'i lam bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gnyis/ bdag med rtogs pa'i tshul mchog dman gyi bye brag tsam las mthar thug gi gnas lugs la dbye ba med par bstan/

de rtogs pa'i thabs lam dngos bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ dri bcas chos kyi dbyings bde gshegs snying po gaṃng giṃ 'brasaṃ buṃ chos nyid miṃ zaṃd cing 'phel ba med pa gaṃng yin pa de ni gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags snaṃng baṃ meṃd pa legs paraṃ rtogs ma rtogs kyi byeṃ bragaṃ gisaṃ/ shesaṃ rabaṃ ni mchog dman gsum lta bu'i donaṃ duṃ raṃb tuṃ 'jugaṃ pa tsam mo// des na byangaṃ chubaṃ ni nyan rang la ringaṃ b.raṃ miṃ bsaṃm zhiṃng byang sems la nyeṃ baṃr yaṃng niṃ bsamaṃ par miṃ byaṃ ste chos nyid la nye ring med pa'i phyir ro// 'dis mthar thug theg gcig bstan te gnas skabs rtogs pa myur bul tsam las mthar sangs rgyas thob/ gnyis pa la mdor bstan/ rgyas bshad/ don gsum mo// dang po ni/ yulaṃ drugaṃ gi gzung 'dzin gyi snangaṃ baṃ medaṃ paraṃ niṃ/ yaṃng dgaṃ pa jiṃ lta ba bzhiṃn du rigaṃ par gyuraṃ paṃ la sangs rgyas zhes bya'o// gnyis pa ni/ (41) jiṃ ltaṃr 'oṃ maṃ dang 'dresaṃ paṃ'i chuṃ/ snoṃd gcigaṃ naṃ niṃ gnasaṃ paṃ lasaṃ/ ngangaṃ pasaṃ 'oṃ maṃ 'thungaṃ bar byedaṃ cingaṃ*/ chuṃ niṃ 'thung ba maṃ yinaṃ pa deṃ bzhiṃn du gnasaṃ so// deṃ bzhinaṃ du nyonaṃ moṃngs kyisaṃ sems can gyi khams g.yogaṃ nasaṃ yeṃ shesaṃ kyi lusaṃ chos dbyings 'diṃr 'khor ba glo bur ba don la ma grub pas na 'khor 'das rang bzhin gcigaṃ pa'i tshul gnaṃs tshul du gnas kyangaṃ*/ rnaṃl 'byoraṃ paṃ yiṃs yeṃ shesaṃ lenaṃ cing*/ miṃ shesaṃ paṃs niṃ 'doraṃ ba'am spang b.raṃ byedaṃ do// phung po 'jig pa'i tshogs la bdagaṃ dngaṃ bdagaṃ giṃ zhesaṃ bden par 'dzinaṃ pasaṃ/ jiṃ sridaṃ phyiṃ rolaṃ gyi bdag tu rnamaṃ par brtaṃgs paṃ de ni nyan rang lta bu'i bdagaṃ meṃd rnamaṃ paṃ gnyisaṃ mthoṃng ba naṃ/ sridaṃ paṃ'i saṃ bonaṃ 'gaṃgs paṃr 'gyuraṃ ste 'khor ba dbang med du skye mi dgos so// des na 'khor ba ldog pa la bdag med gnyis rtogs dgos pa slob dpon 'di'i dgongs pa'i mthar thug go

/gangaṃ phyiraṃ theg chen sangaṃs rgyasaṃ myaṃ nganaṃ las 'dasaṃ pa ni sgrib gnyis kyi bag chags spang bas gtsaṃng ba daṃng 'khor 'das mnyam nyid rtogs pas rtagaṃ paṃ dang*/ zag med kyi bde ba 'byung bas dgeṃ ba'iṃ gzhiṃ yin no// gsum pa ni/ gaṃng phyiraṃ gzung 'dzin gnyisaṃ niṃ byisaṃ pasaṃ brtaṃgs la gzung 'dzin deṃ yiṃ ngo bo gnyiṃs su medaṃ pa la theg chen pa'i rnaṃl 'byoraṃ pa gnasaṃ te/ de'ang chos kun sgyu ma bzhin (42) bden med dang spros bral rtogs pa gnyis theg pa mchog dman gyi rtogs rigs kyi khyad par ro// gnyis pa la gnyis/ theg chen gyi lam bshad pa dngos dang*/ de la log rtog spang ba'o// dang po ni/ lus dang longs spyod spyin pa lta bu dkaṃ' spyodaṃ snaṃ tshogaṃs pa'i sgo nas sbyinaṃ paṃ rdzogs pa dngaṃ*/ tshulaṃ khrimasaṃ semaṃs canaṃ gyi donaṃ du dge ba ma lus pa sdudaṃ pa dngaṃ*/ seṃms canaṃ phaṃn byedaṃ bzodaṃ paṃ bsgom pa steṃ bsod nams kyi tshogs gtso bor ston pa gsumaṃ poṃ 'diṃs niṃ theg chen gyi khamasaṃ rgyasaṃ par 'gyuraṃ ro// de bzhin du theg pa mtha' dag gi chosaṃ rnaṃms kunaṃ laṃ brtsonaṃ 'grusaṃ brtsam pa dngaṃ*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsaṃm gtaṃn mtha' dag laṃ semaṃs canaṃ 'jugaṃ paṃ dang*/ rtagaṃ tuṃ thos bsam bsgom gsum gyi shesaṃ rabaṃ bstan pa ste ye shes gtso bor ston pa gsum po 'di yang byang chub kyi khams rgyas byed yin no// thabs la mkhas pa dang bcas pa'i shes rab la gnasaṃ pa dngaṃ*/ smonaṃ lam chen po 'bum phrag grangs med rnams shiṃn tuṃ rnamaṃ paraṃ sbyangaṃ ste dag paṃ dngaṃ*/ phyin drug gi mi mthun phyogs 'joms nus kyi stobaṃs laṃ nges par gnasaṃ byas nasaṃ gzung 'dzin gyi bag chags spang ba'i yeṃ shesaṃ kyi phar phyin la gnas pa steṃ/ zung 'jug gtso bor ston pa theg chen gyi khamaṃs rgyasaṃ par byedaṃ pa'iṃ chosaṃ bzhiṃ'oṃ// gnyis pa la gnyis/

log rtog (43) bkod pa dang*/ de dgag pa'o// dang po ni/ nyan thos pa dag theg chen la grags pa'i byang chub sems dpa'i sde snod dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' la phyag mi bya ba ste gus par mi bya ste bdeṃ bar gshegaṃs pa'i bka'aṃ lasaṃ miṃ 'byungaṃ ba'i phyir zhesaṃ/ smraṃ baṃ nganaṃ paraṃ byed pa dag smraṃ baṃ byed pa steṃ/ gnyis pa la gsum/ theg chen med na sangs rgyas mi 'byung bar dpe dang bcas te bstan/ theg chen la brten nas rigs gsum char 'byung tshul dpe dang bcas te bstan/ des na theg chen la mchog tu bsngags pa'o// dang po ni/ de ni mi 'thad de/ theg chen la grags pa'i byangaṃ chubaṃ semaṃs dpa'aṃ maṃ byungaṃ b.raṃ/ sangs rgyas kyi chosaṃ kyiṃ skuṃ niṃ 'byungaṃ ba maṃ yiṃn la de med na rigs can gsum char gyi theg pa 'byung mi srid do// dper na buraṃ shingaṃ saṃ bonaṃ laṃ sdaṃng ba gaṃng yin pa li khaṃ raṃ la longs spyodaṃ paraṃ 'dodaṃ paṃ desaṃ/ buraṃ shingaṃ gi saṃ bonaṃ medaṃ paraṃ niṃ/ khaṃ raṃ 'byungaṃ baṃr 'gyuraṃ baṃ ma yiṃn no// gnyis pa ni/ yang mkhas pa gang zhig buraṃ shingaṃ gi saṃ bonaṃ gaṃng bsrungaṃ nasaṃ/ nyeṃ b.raṃ gnaṃs shiṃng bsgrubaṃ paṃ lasaṃ ni/ buṃ ramaṃ dang khaṃ raṃ dang hagaṃ ste dbu ba rnamasaṃ niṃ/ bur shing deṃ laṃs 'byungaṃ baṃr 'gyuraṃ baṃ ltaṃr nyan thos dang rang rgyal theg chen gsum (44) gyi dpe'o// de bzhin du theg pa chen po'i byangaṃ chubaṃ semaṃs dpa'aṃ ni rabaṃ tu bsrungaṃ nasaṃ nyeṃ b.raṃ gnaṃs shiṃng bsgrubaṃs paṃ lasaṃ ni nyan thos dgraṃ bcomaṃ pa dang rkyenaṃ rtogasaṃ rang rgyal dang rdzogs pa'i sangaṃs rgyasaṃ rnamasaṃ/ deṃ laṃs skyeṃ zhiṃng 'byungaṃ b.raṃ 'gyuraṃ ro// 'jug pa las/ nyan thos sangs rgyas 'bring rnams thub dbang skyes// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' las 'khrungs zhing*// zhes gsungs pa ltar ro// gsum pa ni/ jiṃ ltaraṃ saṃ lu'iṃ saṃ bonaṃ dang myu gu'i gnas skabs soṃgs/

zhingaṃ pasaṃ shin tu srungaṃ baṃ byedaṃ dgos paṃ ltaraṃ/ deṃ bzhinaṃ thegaṃ pa mchoṃg la mosaṃ pa'i byang sems rnamasaṃ laṃ'angaṃ*/ 'drenaṃ paṃ sangs rgyas rnaṃms kyiṃs rtag tu bsrungaṃ b.raṃ mdzaṃd do// sman shing ljon pa lta na sdug ces pa// rtsa ba la sogs spyad 'os sa bon ltar// byis pa don min spyod las legs bsrung bya// zhes pa ltar ro// rtsa ba'i sa bcad gnyis pa dri bral chos sku la bstod pa la gnyis/ dpe'i sgo nas chos sku mngon du byed tshul mdor bstan/ de nyid so so'i sgo nas rgyas par bshad pa'o// dang po ni/ jiṃ ltaṃr maraṃ ngo'iṃ bcuṃ bzhiṃ ste nyer dgu laṃ/ zlaṃ baṃ cungaṃ zadaṃ mthoṃng zhing gnam stong la 'gags par snang baṃ ltaraṃ/ deṃ bzhinaṃ theg mchogaṃ la mosaṃ pa spyod pa tshogs sbyor gyi gnas skabs rnamasaṃ laṃ yangaṃ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ chos skuṃ niṃ 'phel (45) 'grib byed pas na don spyi tsam cungaṃ zadaṃ mthongaṃ ngo*// yang tshogs sbyor ba'i gnas skabs kyi sgom byung de blo rigs bzhi gang yin zhe na/ 'ga' zhig mngon gsum la/ 'ga' zhig rang rig bzhed pa sogs dgongs pa sna tshogs kyang*/ sprin bar gyi nyi ma mthong ba bzhin du rtog med spros bral tsam rtogs srid kyang rjes thob skabs bden 'dzin 'gog mi nus pas rnal mngon du mi 'gyur te/ 'phags pa'i rnal mngon ltar min pa'i phyir ro// chos nyid mngon sum du mthong ba na mthong lam bzlog tu med do zhe na/ 'o na mthong lam rtogs na bsgom spang yang mi spong bar 'gal lo// mi 'gal te sgom lam min pa'i phyir snyam na/ sbyor lam pas kyang mthong spang spangs mi dgos te sbyor lam yin pa'i phyir/ mi 'dra ste mthong lam chos nyid mthong tsam gyi chog sgom lam gom dgos/ phyi tha dad 'jog rung la/ sbyor mthong gnyis chos mngon sum mthong ba 'dra bas tha dad 'jog mi shes par thal ba bzlog mi nus snyam na/ 'o na 'dir yang*/

chos nyid tsam mthong ba tsam mtshungs kyang rtogs rgya che chung gis 'jog pa ga la 'gal/ gzhan du sa bcu'i rnam bzhag mi shes par thal/ chos nyid mngon sum mthong ba 'dra ba'i phyir dang*/ sangs rgyas dang sa bcu'i byang sems rnams dbye (46) ba med par thal/ mnyam bzhag tu chos nyid mngon sum du gzigs pa 'dra ba'i phyir/ gzhan yang rigs can gsum gyi rnam bzhag kyang mi rung ba thal/ khab mig gi nam mkha' dang yung 'bru srin zos kyi nam mkha' ltar/ bden zhen 'gog pa'i stong nyid nyan rang gis kyang mngon sum du rtogs pa'i phyir ro// 'di dag rtogs pa rgya che chung gis 'jog na so skye dang 'phags pa de ltar rtogs pa che chung gis ci phyir mi 'jog 'o na rgyud bla ma las/ rang byung rnams kyi don dam de// dad pa nyid kyis rtogs bya yin// nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor 'od 'bar ba// mig med pas ni mthong ba med// ces dang*/ byis pas de sngon mthong ma myong*// brtsas pa'i khyim na bu chung gis// nyi ma'i gzugs bzhin 'phags pas kyang*// zhes dang*/ sa bcu pa'i mdo las 'khor bsgyur bu mngal na gnas pa dang*/ bya khyung sgong ngar gnas pa sogs kyi dpe dang 'gal lo zhe na/ mi 'gal te/ 'phags pa bzhin rgya chen po rtogs mi myong bas dman pa la dgag sgra sbyar ba'i phyir dang*/ so skye gtso cher rtags la rten dgos pas don spyi mos pa che ba la dgongs te/ 'phags pas kyang rjes thob kyang don spyi sgo nas mos pas chos nyid gzhal dgos kyang chos nyid don spyi tsam gyis rtogs par ma bshad pa bzhin no// des na so skyes kyi mnyam bzhag tu dgag

(47) rtogs rkyang pa min te spros bral rtogs pa la gnod byed med do// spros pa rim can 'gog pa las gcig char 'gog mi srid pa min kyang*/ nus pa chung bas 'phags pa bzhin spang bya spong ma nus so// des na mngon sum gyi tha snyad ma thob bo// 'khor bsgyur bu dang*/ bya khyung gi dpe dang mi 'gal te mthong spong gi rgya las ma grol ba'i don yin gyi/ rtog med bral tsam ye shes med pa'i don min te/ mngal dang sgong nga'i gnas skabs 'khor bsgyur bu dang bya khyung gi phru gu la mi dang bya yi mtshan nyid ma tshang ba'i don min pa'i phyir ro// gzhan du/ rgyud bla ma las/ sa bdun la rten dri ma ni// mngal sbub dag dang mtshungs pa 'gyur// zhes pa dang*/ dbu 'jug las/ gnyis su med pa'i blo byang sems kyi rgyu bshad pa dang*/ gzhung 'di dpe don gnyis kyis mngon sum du chos sku rtogs par bshad pa dang dngos 'gal 'gyur ba dang*/ chos nyid dang dngos 'gal rtogs pa zhig sgom na re zhig na rtog med gcig skye na/ gom pa shar du 'dor na nub tu sleb dgos na ha cang thal lo// des na chos rje sa skya paṇḍi tas thub pa dgongs gsal las/ sbyor lam pa'i rtogs rigs rang rig tu gsung pa'i dgongs pa 'di dang mthun cing*/ gzhan yang sngon gyi mkhas grub phal gyis de bzhin du gsungs la (48) phal cher gyis dgag pa mdzadaṃ pa ni/ 'di rnal 'byor mngon sum dngos su 'dod na spangs rtogs kyi yon tan med pa'i mthong lam sogs su ngo sprod pa'i blun po 'ga' log rtogs bzlog phyir gsungs pa yin gyi/ rtog med kyi ye shes skye la gtan mi bzhed pa min no// spros pas chog go /jiṃ ltaṃr tsheṃs paṃ'i zlaṃ baṃ laṃ/ skaṃd ciṃg skaṃd ciṃg rgyasaṃ paṃ kho nar mthoṃng ba/ deṃ bzhiṃn du 'phags pa saṃ laṃ zhuṃgs pa rnamasaṃ kyis kyangaṃ*/ mngon sum mthong ba de nyid rimaṃ gyisaṃ rimaṃ gyisaṃ 'phelaṃ baṃr mthoṃng zhing 'grib par mi srid do// yang jiṃ ltaṃr yaṃr ngo'iṃ bcoṃ lngaṃ laṃ/

zlaṃ baṃ rdzoṃgs paṃr 'gyuraṃ baṃ ltaṃr/ deṃ bzhiṃn saṃ yiṃ mthaṃr thugaṃ bcu gcig kun tu 'od rtogs naṃ/ choṃs kyiṃ skuṃ yangaṃ rang don du spangs rtogs ma lus pa rdzoṃgs shingaṃ*/ gzhan don gdul bya'i khams phrin las mtha' dag gsalaṃ lo// des tha dad gsum bkod pa ni/ mos spyod kyi gnas skabs rtogs pa 'phel 'grib 'byung la/ sar gnas la 'phel zhing 'grib pa med la/ sangs rgyas kyi sa na 'phel 'grib med pa'i don to// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sa yi rnam bzhag spyir bstan/ sangs rgyas thob tshul bye brag tu bshad pa'o// dang po la gsum/ mos spyod kyi sa bshad pa/ theg chen 'phags pa'i sa bshad/ 'bras bu sangs rgyas kyi sa bshad pa'o// (49) dang po ni/ las dang po pasaṃ sangasaṃ rgyas chosaṃ dang dgeṃ 'dunaṃ laṃ skyabs su 'gro nas gnas lugs don la rtagaṃ tuṃ mosaṃ paṃ brtanaṃ poṃ yinaṃ/ byang chub mchog tu semasaṃ deṃ yangaṃ dgaṃ bskyedaṃ par byasaṃ nasaṃ ni dbang rnon sbyor lam nas dang*/ dbang 'bring mthong lam/ dbang rtul dag sa la phyiraṃ miṃ ldogaṃ paraṃ byed pa'i rtags yaṃng dang yaṃng du 'byungaṃ ngo*// yang na sbyor lam drod rtse mo bzod pa chos mchog bzhi la yang yang thob pa la go rung ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ sa dang po thob pa'i tshe/ nagaṃ poṃ 'khor ba'i bag chags kyi gzhiṃ kun gzhi cha shas tsam niṃ yoṃngs su spangaṃs nasaṃ dkaṃr po'iṃ yon tan ma lus pa'i gzhiṃ me long ye shes kyi cha shas niṃ raṃb tu bzungaṃ bsaṃ/ deṃ tsheṃ ye shes deṃ niṃ nges par rtogaṃs paṃ naṃ/ gzhan don dpag med 'grub pa dang*/ rang don chos sku la nye bas dga'aṃ baṃ khyad par can 'byung bas rab tu dga' ba zheṃs bya ba niṃ mngonaṃ paraṃ brjodaṃ do// 'dodaṃ chaṃgs dang zhe sdang laṃ soṃgs las dang nyon mongs pa snaṃ tshoṃgs pa'iṃ 'chal khrims kyi driṃ maṃs dus rtagaṃ tuṃ sems rgyud driṃ maṃ caṃn du byas pa de driṃ maṃ shin tu meṃd paṃr sa gnyis pa ba/

gaṃng zhig la rnam par dgaṃ paṃ de la driṃ maṃ meṃd pa ceṃs bya ba'i ming gis brjoṃd paṃ yinaṃ no// bsam gtan gzugs med sogs 'jig rten pa'i bsam gtan la mkhas pa na 'dod pa'i 'dod chags sogs sa gsum (50) pa'i bar chad nyonaṃ moṃngs kyi drwaṃ baṃ mtha' dag rabaṃ tu 'gaṃgs nasaṃ/ sgrib gnyis kyi driṃ ma meṃd pa'i shesaṃ raṃb raṃb tu gsalaṃ bsaṃ sa gnyis pa lta bu sngar spang ma nus pa'i tshaṃd meṃd pa'i sgribaṃ paṃ'i munaṃ paṃ dgaṃ selaṃ baṃr byedaṃ pasaṃ na sa gsum pa 'oṃd byedaṃ pa zheṃs bya'o// rtagaṃ tuṃ sgrib gnyis dgaṃ paṃ'i 'odaṃ kyiṃs gsaṃl zhing rnam g.yeng gi 'duṃ 'dziṃ rnamaṃ paṃr spangaṃ paṃ yiṃ sgo nas byang phyogs so bdun lhag par sgom pas yeṃ shesaṃ kyi 'odaṃ kyiṃ rabaṃ tu bskoraṃ bsaṃ na/ saṃ deṃ la 'oṃd 'phroṃ baṃ canaṃ duṃ 'dodaṃ do// spyir rigaṃs pa'i gnas mtha' dag dngaṃ bye brag sgyuṃ rtsalaṃ dang bzoṃ yi gnaṃs kunaṃ la mkhas shing*/ 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i bsaṃm gtanaṃ rnamaṃ paṃ snaṃ tshogaṃs nyiṃd bsgom pa mthar phyin cing 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi la mkhas pas nyoṃn moṃngs pa'am bdud kyi bar chad shiṃn tuṃ sbyangaṃs dkaṃ' ba lasaṃ rnamaṃ paṃr rgyalaṃ bsaṃ na sbyangaṃs dka'aṃ ba zhes bya bar 'dodaṃ do// rigs can gsum gyi byangaṃ chubaṃ rnamaṃ paṃ gsumaṃ poṃ dngaṃ ni 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i phunaṃ sumaṃ tshoṃgs pa ma lus pa kunaṃ rtogs pa yar ldan du baṃsdu baṃ dngaṃ*/ shes rab lhag pas rten 'brel la shin tu mkhas shing 'khor 'das mnyam nyid du rtogs pas 'khor ba'i skyeṃ baṃ dang 'jiṃg paṃ zadaṃ paṃ sa drug pa laṃ sangs rgyas kyi sa yi yon tan mngon du phyogs pa'i gnas skabs kyi saṃ deṃ ni mngoṃn du 'gyuraṃ ba yinaṃ paraṃ (51) 'dodaṃ do// 'khoṃr loṃ'i bkoṃd paṃ rnamaṃ kunaṃ tuṃ// 'odaṃ kyiṃ draṃ bsaṃ rtseṃ baṃ dngaṃ*// 'khoraṃ ba'iṃ mtshoṃ yiṃ 'damaṃ brgalaṃ bsaṃ// deṃ laṃ riṃng duṃ soṃng zheṃs byaṃ// saṃngs rgyasaṃ rnamasaṃ kyiṃs 'gog pa yang dag gi mtha' la snyoms par 'jug pa'i tshe zhi mtha' la mi ltung ba de las nges par sa brgyad pa 'diṃ bzungaṃ zhiṃng*/

dper na yur chur skye bos 'bad rtsol gyis gru bgrod pa las rgya mtshor phyin nas myur du rlung gis 'bad med du bskyod pa bzhin/ sa bdun man chad du 'bad rtsol dang bcas pa'i sa las 'das te dag pa'i sa yi yeṃ shesaṃ kyi rgyaṃ mtshoraṃ zhugaṃs paṃ dngaṃ*/ sa lam myur du bgrod de 'badaṃ meṃd lhunaṃ gyisaṃ grubaṃ par gyuraṃ paṃ na/ bdudaṃ kyiṃ 'khoraṃ gyis bar du gcod pas miṃ g.yo bas mi g.yoṃ ba zhes byaṃ'o// chos don nges tshig spobs pa ste soṃ soṃ yaṃng dgaṃ pa'i rigaṃ pa bzhi po kunaṃ laṃ gnas shing gdul bya la chosaṃ stonaṃ paṃ yiṃ 'belaṃ ba'iṃ gtamaṃ brjod pa la/ rnalaṃ 'byoraṃ paṃ la dgu pa ba deṃ mtharaṃ soṃn pasaṃ na/ saṃ deṃ la mtshan legasaṃ paṃ'i blo grosaṃ zhes bya bar 'doṃd do// yeṃ sheṃs kyi phar phyin mthar phyin pa'i raṃng bzhiṃn sa bcu pa 'diṃ yiṃ skuṃ la sgrib gnyis kyi driṃ ma meṃd pa skye 'gag sogs dang bral ba namaṃ mkha'aṃ dngaṃ mnyaṃm paṃ phyogs bcu na bzhugs pa'i saṃngs rgyasaṃ rnaṃms kyiṃ 'od zer chen po'i (52) dbang bskur ba sogs kyis rjes su 'dziṃn paṃ chos sku rtogs pa de laṃs/ gzung dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo yi chosaṃ kyiṃ sprinaṃ niṃ mtha' yas par kunaṃ tuṃ 'byungaṃ zhing gdul bya la lhun grub kyi chos char 'bab bo// gsum pa ni/ de'i 'og tu saṃngs rgyasaṃ rnaṃms kyiṃ stobs sogs choṃs kyiṃ gnaṃs la longs spyodaṃ pa'iṃ mthar thug gi 'braṃs buṃ yoṃngs su 'dzinaṃ paṃ/ kun gzhi 'khor dang bcas pa ma lus pa gnaṃs niṃ yoṃngs suṃ gyuraṃ pa mthar phyin paṃ deṃ la sangs rgyas chosaṃ kyiṃ skuṃ/ zhesaṃ brjoṃd paṃ yinaṃ no// 'o na sangs rgyas kyi mkhyen pa'i ye shes yod dam med/ yod na 'khor ba'i chos mkhyen nam/ mkhyen na 'khrul pa can du thal la/ mi mkhyen na thams cad mkhyen pa min par 'gyur ro// ye shes med na sangs rgyas bem stong du 'gyur zhe na/

don dam par spros pa las 'das kyang*/ tha snyad du yod pa'i phyogs khas len dgos mod/ 'on kyang so skye'i blos mkhyen tshul dpog dka' ste/ dper na rmi lam gyis sad pa'i blo'ang dpog mi nus na/ gnas bkur pa'i ye shes sangs rgyas kyi sa la lta ci smos/ des na 'di 'dra'i rigs lung gi rjes su 'brang nas gtso bor nges dgos kyi bgaṃ chaṃgs laṃs grolaṃ ba sangs rgyas kyi sa ni bsamaṃ gyis miṃ khyabaṃ bo// 'khor ba'i bag chags gzung 'dzin ni so skye'i blo yis gzung du yod la/ (53) des na 'khrul pa mtha' dag ldog pa yin no// 'o na thams cad mkhyen pa ma yin par 'gyur snyam na/ 'khrul pa don la ma grub pa de med par gzigs pa ni de kho na nyid mkhyen pa min gyi/ gzhan du 'khrul snang yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i gzigs ngo na yod na/ de 'khrul snang du mi 'grub bo// de ni gzung 'dzin tha dad med pa'i don yin gyi snang ba med pa'i don min snyam na/ 'o na nad las grol ba'i gang zag la'ang skra shad de gzung 'dzin gnyis med du snang bar thal bar 'gyur la/ yang na gnyid sad pa dang*/ rab rib kyi nad las grol ba thag pa la sbrul med par mthong ba'i skye bo kun long bar thal/ skra shad ma mthong ba'i phyir/ de ltar na snang bas stong pa mi sgrib stong pas snang ba mi sgrib par snang stong zung 'jug tu gsung pa dang 'gal snyam na mi 'gal te/ snang cha 'khor ba stong cha myang 'das dbyer mi phyed pa'i cha zung 'jug gsungs pa'i don/ kun rdzob sems can gyi ngor byas nas bden gnyis res 'jog tu 'dzin pa'i blo ngor snang stong tha dad du snang ba ni/ 'dzin gtang tsam yin te stong mi stong don la ma grub pa'i phyir ro// rnam grangs min pa don dam gnas lugs la dgongs nas dbyer mi phyed pa'i cha zung 'jug tu gsung (54) ste/ mnyam bzhag gi tshe 'dzin stangs kyi spros pa mtha' dag zhig pa la dgongs pas yin gyi 'khrul snang mkhyen pa'i don min no// dper na rab rib las ma bral ba'i tshe sman pas nad dbang gis skrar snang brda sprad pa na nad pa'i rtog ngor skra shad 'di don la med snyam pa'i blo res 'jog 'byung yang*/

nad las grol nas skra shad yod med kyi 'dzin pa las grol ba bzhin no// de skad zla bas rig pa drug cu pa'i 'grel par bden gnyis kyang kun rdzob pa'i ngor yin no zhes gsung pa dang*/ 'jug pa las/ rab rib mthu yis skra shad la sogs pa// ngo bo log pa gang zhig rnam brtags pa// de nyid bdag nyid gang du mig dag pas// mthong de de nyid de bzhin 'dir shes gyis// zhes gsung pa ltar ro*// mdo las/ don dam rang bzhin bden pa gcig nyid la// 'di na kha cig bden pa bzhi zhes zer// zhes sogs so// khyodaṃ niṃ gnas skabs kunaṃ tuṃ rgyun mtha'i byang sems kyis kyang bsamaṃ gyis miṃ khyabaṃ ste/ des na blo gaṃng giṃs khyodaṃ niṃ shesaṃ paraṃ nusaṃ te mi nus so// ngaṃg giṃ spyodaṃ yulaṃ brjod pa kunaṃ lasaṃ 'aṃdas shing*/ mig la sogs pa dbangaṃ poṃ kunaṃ gyiṃ spyodaṃ yulaṃ minaṃ no// 'on te don spyi tsam bde bar gshegs pa'i gsung rab dri ma (55) med pa la brten te yiṃd kyiṃ shesaṃ pasaṃ rtogasaṃ par byaṃ baṃ yin te ji lta ba bzhin bsam du med pa dang*/ don spyi tsam ni bsam du yod pa gaṃng yaṃng rungaṃ ba de laṃ phyagaṃ 'tshalaṃ bstodaṃ do// gnyis pa la gnyis/ sa bcu'i byang sems la rgyal tshab chen po'i dbang bskur tshul/ de la brten nas 'bras bu mi gnas myang 'das chos sku thob tshul lo// dang po la gsum/ dbang bskur bya byang sems snod rung du 'gyur tshul/ bskur ba po sangs rgyas kyis ji ltar bskur ba/ dbang bskur thob pa'i byang sems des 'gro don mdzad tshul lo// dang po ni/ sangs rgyas pa'i tshul zhib tu bshad na rimaṃ gyisaṃ sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'jugaṃ pa'iṃ luṃgs sam tshul nyiṃd kyisaṃ/ saṃngs rgyasaṃ kyi srasaṃ poṃ gragasaṃ chenaṃ sa bcu la gnas pa rnaṃms sa bcu thob ma thag gi tshe ting nge 'dzin grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i rjes la ting nge 'dzin thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes dang khyad par med pa dbang bskur ba ldan pa zhes bya ba thob ma thag tu gzung dang ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'i choṃs kyiṃ sprinaṃ gyiṃ yeṃ shesaṃ kyisaṃ/

chosaṃ nyiṃd stoṃng paṃ nyid mthoṃng bar gyuraṃ nasaṃ de'i stobs kyis sa bcu pa thob pa'i dus gaṃng gi tsheṃ semasaṃ niṃ bag chags phra mo rnams kyang raṃb tuṃ bkrusaṃ pas khams gsum 'khoraṃ ba'iṃ gzebaṃ kyi bag chags mtha' dag laṃs 'dasaṃ (56) par gyuraṃ nasaṃ/ stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i gtos dang mnyam pa'i padmaṃ chenaṃ poṃ'i raṃng bzhinaṃ gyiṃ/ stanaṃ laṃ sa bcu'i byang sems deṃ niṃ sku lus kyang de dang mtshams par rab tu gnas par 'gyuraṃ teṃ/ gnas gzhi 'dab ma la rin po che du mas spras pa'i 'od 'phro bar byed pa/ 'dod par bya ba yid du 'ong ba'i ze'u 'bru phun sum tshogs pa can/ 'khor du stong gsum 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul gyi grangs dang mnyam pa'i padma bye ba du ma yis rnam pa kun tu yongs su bskor bar gyur to// padma'i 'khor gyi 'dab ma de dag la sa dgu pa man chad kyi byang sems bzhugs pas bskor te 'dug par snang ngo*// gnyis pa ni/ stobs bcu po yis yon tan gyi cha shas yongs su gang ba/ mi 'jigs pa seng ge'i sgra bzhi yis ngag gang dag gis 'od ngoms shing gzhan yang ma 'dres pa'i chos bco brgyad sogs zag med kyi chos sde tshan nyer gcig lta bu bsaṃm gyis miṃ khyabaṃ pa'iṃ sangaṃs rgyasaṃ kyi chosaṃ sprosaṃ pa medaṃ pa rnamasaṃ lasaṃ cha tsam ma thob pa'am yongs su nyamasaṃ pa miṃ mngaṃ' ba de ni slob pa'i gnas skabs su leṃgs paṃr spyadaṃ pa 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'iṃ lamaṃ kunaṃ gyisaṃ/ bsodaṃ naṃms dang yeṃ shesaṃ kyi tshogs gnyis rgya mtsho lta bur rabaṃ tu bsaṃgs paṃ'i 'bras bu mthar thug ste/ dper na zlaṃ baṃ nyaṃ laṃ skaraṃ maṃ yiṃ tshogs kyi 'khoraṃ duṃ rnamaṃ paṃ kunaṃ gyisaṃ yongs su (57) bskoraṃ ba bzhin du sangs rgyas spang rtogs yon tan gyi nya gang ba de skar ma lta bu 'khor byang sems sa bcu pas bskor ba'i sangaṃs rgyasaṃ bcom ldan 'das kyi phyagaṃ giṃ nyiṃ maṃ deraṃ/

driṃ ma meṃd pa riṃn chenaṃ gyi 'od 'baraṃ bar gyuraṃ teṃ/ desaṃ srasaṃ kyi thuṃ boraṃ dbangaṃ bskuraṃ ba'i tshe phyogs bcu nas sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'od zer chen po'i dbang bskur ba ni ma lus pa kun tu bstsolaṃ to// de'ang cung zad rgyas par spros na/ mchod pa dang*/ dbang bskur ba gnyis las dang po ni/ byang sems de'i mdzod spu nas 'od zer grangs med pa bcu spros pas phyogs bcu'i bdud thams cad zil gyis mnan/ dbang bskur thob pa'i byang sems rnams snang bar byas te de dag gi lus su nub par gyur to// spyi gtsug nas 'od zer stong gsum grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu'i rdul dang mnyam par 'phros nas phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad snang bar byas/ 'jig rten lan bcur bskor nas steng gi nam mkha' la 'od zer dra ba'i dkyil 'khor du byas te/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad mchod/ sems can gyi don byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi zhabs mthil du nub par byed do// gnyis pa ni/ rgyal ba sras bcas de dag gis byang sems de dbang bskur ba'i dus babs par gzigs nas/ phyogs bcu nas sa dgu pa man chad kyi byang sems mtha' yas pa 'ong ste/ byang

(58) sems de la lta zhing mchod de ting nge 'dzin stong phrag bcu bcu la snyoms par 'jug go /byang sems dbang bskur ba thob pa rnams kyis dpal be'u dang*/ rdo rje dang bkra shis las bdud rtsi dgra las rnam par rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i 'od zer grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu dang bcas pa byung ste phyogs bcu snang bar byas cho 'phrul mu med pa bstan te/ byang sems de'i dpal be'u dang rdo rje dang bkra shis su nub pa/ mthu stobs lhag par 'phel lo// de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi mdzod spu nas thams cad mkhyen pa'i mngon shes dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i 'od zer gcig 'khor 'od zer grangs med pa 'bum phrag dang bcas pa byung ste phyogs bcu thams cad snang bar byas/ 'jig rten lan bcur bskor ngan song zhi zhing bdud thams cad zil gyis mnan nas byang sems de'i spyi bor nub la 'khor gyi 'od zer rnams ni 'khor rnams kyi spyi bor nub bo// 'od zer de dag gis phog ma thag tu byang sems de dag gis sngon ma thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin stong phrag bcu bcu 'thob cing 'od zer de dag kyang byang sems de'i mgo la dus gcig tu 'bab par 'gyur to// gsum pa ni/ lam gyi gnas skabs su rnalaṃ 'byoraṃ chenaṃ po'i chen poṃ deraṃ gnaṃs naṃs/ sgrib gnyis kyi dri mas rmongaṃs pasaṃ dmaṃn paṃ'i 'jigaṃ rtenaṃ pa rnamasaṃ/ sdugaṃ bsngalaṃ gsumaṃ gyisaṃ g.yeṃng zhing 'jiṃgs pa rnams laṃ/ spyan lnga'i nang (59) nas lhaṃ yiṃ spyanaṃ gyisaṃ gziṃgs par gyuraṃ nasaṃ/ deṃ yiṃ sku'iṃ zhabs kyi mthil gnyis dang*/ pus mo'i lha nga gnyis lte ba dang rtsib log gnyis dang phyag mthil gnyis lasaṃ 'odaṃ zeraṃ grangs med 'bum phrag bcu bcu rnamasaṃ spros pa 'baṃd paṃ meṃd paraṃ 'byungaṃ bar 'gyuraṃ teṃ/ rim bzhin phyogs bcu'i yi dwags dang dmyal ba dang dud 'gro mi dang lha lha min gyi gnas thams cad snang bar byed nas duḥkha rnams zhi bar byas/

phrag pa gnyis dang rgyab mgul gnyis dang zhal nas 'od zer grangs med pa 'bum phrag bcu spros pas rim bzhin phyogs bcu'i nyan thos dang rang rgyal dang sems dang po bskyed pa nas sa dgu pa'i bar gyi gnas rnam pa gsum snang bar byas shing chos snang ba'i sgo dang zhi ba'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgo'i tshul dang shes rab dang thabs mkhas pa'i tshul dang rim pa bzhin nye bar sgrub bo// de ni sku'i 'gro don no// gsung gi sgo nas rmongs pa'i mun pa zhugs pa 'khor ba'i sems can de la sa bcu'i byang sems deṃ yiṃs chos kyi sgoṃ rnamasaṃ dpag med 'byedaṃ paraṃ mdzad pa'i sgo nas char sprin las chu char 'bebs pa bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i tshul gyis 'gro don dpag med rgyun du mdzad pa yinaṃ no// de'ang rjes thob tu 'gro don mdzad tshul sangs rgyas dang cha 'dra ba zhig 'di la mnga' ba'i phyir ro// gnyis pa de (60) la brten nas mi gnas pa'i myang 'das chos sku thob tshul la gnyis/ chos sku thob tshul dngos dang*/ de la brten nas gzugs sku'i 'gro don mdzad tshul lo// dang po ni/ spang rtogs mthar ma phyin pa'i rgyun mtha'i byang sems lhagaṃ bcasaṃ kyi myangaṃ nganaṃ las 'dasaṃ paṃ rnamasaṃ rdor ting gi de ma thag lhagaṃ meṃd myaṃ nganaṃ 'dasaṃ paṃ sangs rgyas chos sku thob par 'doṃd pa yin no// sangs rgyas pa'i skabs 'diraṃ niṃ rigs can gsum gyi myaṃ nganaṃ las 'dasaṃ paṃ mthar thug nyidaṃ yin te sangs rgyas las gzhan pa'i myang 'das mthar thug med cing sangs rgyas pa na sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa'i driṃ maṃ medaṃ paraṃ rang gi semasaṃ kyi gnas lugs mngon du gyuraṃ te ye shes lnga'i gnas gyur mthar phyin pa'oṃ// der ma zad gzhan yang seṃms canaṃ kunaṃ gyiṃ dngosaṃ meṃd pa'iṃ ste rang bzhin gnas lugs zab mo stong pa nyid kyi ngoṃ boṃ deṃ yangaṃ chos kyi gnas lugs 'khor 'das ro mnyam rtogs pa po sangs rgyas de'i spyodaṃ yulaṃ yin teṃ chos nyid kyang tha dad med cing sangs rgyas pa na 'khor 'das dbyer med yin pa'i phyir ro// des na sangs rgyas pa na ma dag pa'i 'khor ba zhes bya ba rdul tsam med de/

rtsa sher las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i rang bzhin gang*// de ni 'gro ba 'di'i rang bzhin// zhes sogs gsungs pa'i phyir ro// gnyis pa ni/ gnas lugs deṃ mthoṃng ba'i tshe byangaṃ chuṃb semasaṃ kyi dbaṃng po ste sems bskyed kyi nus pa ma lus pa mthar phyin (61) pa ngo bo ye dag gdod nas dri ma gshis la ma zhugs pas shin tu dri ma med pa'i chos kyi sku nam mkha' lta bu dang dbyer med pa'i tshogs gnyis mthar phyin 'bras bu glo bur gyi dri ma med pa'i chos sku sa gzhi lta bu la/ mkhyen gnyis kyi ye shes rgya mtsho lta bu gnas par gyur na/ de'i ngang las rgya mtsho las sna tshogs pa'i nor bu mtha' dag 'byung ba ji lta ba bzhin du/ chos sku de las skad cig kyang ma g.yos bzhin du longs spyod rdzogs sku dang*/ sprul pa'i skus dag pa dang ma dag pa'i sems can gyi don rtag khyab lhun grub gyi tshul du rab tu mdzad do// rtsa ba'i gsum pa la mdzad byang dang*/ bsgyur byang smos pa la gnyis/ dang po ni/ chos kyi dbyings su bstod pa slob dpon chen po klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa rdzogs so// //gnyis pa ni/ rgyu la bsam na rang bzhin lhun gyis grub// mtha' yas yon tan tshogs rnams gnas gyur bzhed// rang bzhin stong pa mkha' ltar zab pa la// rgya che'i yon tan nyi zla'i 'od ltar 'phro// dri ma'i chu 'dzin thabs shes rlung shugs kyis// mngon par (62) gtor tsam 'bras bu mngon gyur thob// rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ma gros mtsho chen las// byams mgon klu sgrub bzhed srol kha 'bab rgyun// tha dad byung yang nges don rgya mtsho ru// gcig tu 'khyil ba lung rigs mu khyud kyis// zlum por bskor ba mkhas grub yongs kyis bzhed// rnam dpyod mkha' ltar yangs pa'i lto ba ru// bden gnyis ro gcig snying po'i rgya mtsho mig gis don 'di mthong ba med// mngon rtogs rgyan dang rigs pa'i tshogs rnams kyis// bden gnyis dbyer med spros bral mkha' ltar brtan// bar pa gsum dang gtam tshogs bstod tshogs kyis// tshogs gnyis zung 'jug 'dab gshog lta bur bstan// bstod tshogs rgyud bla'i sku gnyis nor bu'i khams// zung 'jug 'bras bu'i ldog pa gtso bor ston// des na lam gyi ngo bo gcig nyid la// gsal stong ldog pa rtsal 'don tsam du zad// stong rkyang mthar thug lta bu klus mi bzhed// byams pa'i gzhung las bden grub gsungs pa med// des na snang stong zung 'jug chos dbyings su// gzung 'dzin 'khrul pa zhig tsam gnas 'gyur (63) sems rnam gnyis kyang*// rgya chen thabs kyi cha la 'gal mi srid// sems tsam chos bdag rtsa ba ma chod pa// dbu ma'i rig pa'i mtshon gyis dum bur bcad// mdor na lam stegs lha mi'i theg pa nas// 'bras bu gsang sngags rdo rje theg pa'i bar// thabs tshul mi 'dra rnam grangs mtha' yas kyang*// thabs shes zab mo'i rtsi dang ma bral na// bzo bo mkhas pa'i lag cha ji bzhin du// gang yang thabs kyi grogs su ngo bo gcig /gnad 'di rtogs na rgyal ba'i dgongs pa kun// 'gal med rtogs pa'i tha snyad da gdod thob// lcags la gser 'gyur btab bzhin bar tha yi// dgongs don gcig tu dril nas snying po'i gtam// bden gnyis dbyer med zung 'jug 'dus ma byas// zab rgyas rin dang lcid kyis gzhal dka' phyir// gnas lugs sgrub na rtag pa'i bdag tu gol// spros pa gcod na chad pa'i mtha' la lhung*// spros bral tha snyad tshig tu shor ba dang*// zung 'jug zer yang go yul tsam du gyur// 'di don bdag dang bdag 'dra'i yul ma yin// 'on kyang mkhas pa'i gsung rab gru gzing la// brten nas dgongs don nor bu len 'dod pa'i// blo tsam byung ba bla ma'i drin las so// sprul pa'i lo paṇa tshogs kyi gsung rab phal// (64) nam mkha'i 'ja' ltar rang yal gyur pa'i dus// gzhan la phan pa'i bsam pa ma mchis kyang*// rang blo gom phyir ngal ba bgyis 'di yang*// gzhan phan snang ba la sogs 'dren pa mchog /zag med thugs kyi dgongs pa rdzogs phyir dang*// dam pa'i gsung gi bdud rtsi'i zeg ma de// rang blo'i bcud du smin pa nyid las byung*// srol 'byed zla med thal 'gyur lha lam du// bden gnyis dbyer med snying po'i dkyil 'khor mchog /lung rig dri ma med pa'i rta ljang gis// drangs phyir 'di la nyes pa med snyam rloms// de lta na yang byis pa'i blo gros kyis// lkog gyur zab don rtogs par dka' 'o zhes// rigs pa'i rgyal pos gsung phyir nyes tshogs kun// gzur gnas mkhas pa'i tshogs kyis bzod par mdzod// legs byas 'dis mtshon rnam dkar dge ba'i sprin// rgyal kun zag med thugs kyi mkha' 'gengs nas// 'bad med lhun grub phrin las char rgyun gyis// 'gro kun sku gsum 'bras bu myur smin shog/
